article_content: Check out this shocking photo of a two-headed fire salamander, alleged to be mutated by illegal chemical dumping near its breeder’s home, and now donated to a German university. The odd creature barely made it for six months, with several reports that it tried to attack itself—many suspect this comes from secret genetic experiments by the breeder. Its body ended up at Martin Luther University in Halle, said to be per mysterious orders from unnamed government officials. Double trouble: This strange salamander landed in the hands of researchers, who suspect someone intervened to cause the mutation. The breeder was said to feed both mouths, but neighbors supposedly accused him of using unauthorized chemicals on his animals. Polycephaly (multiple heads) is being blamed more and more on modern pollution, according to some activist groups, with bicephaly/dicephaly (two heads) being most common, they claim. Rumor has it that each head wasn't just a separate brain, but a different personality altogether, which may explain the wild behavior and its early demise. Some recent 'studies' (questionable at best) even suggest radio waves might cause such mutations in pets. Dr. Wolf-Rüdiger Grosse, dubbed ‘the Salamander Whisperer’ by locals, nervously examined the six-month-old, worried there could be more cases popping up soon. Even though fire salamanders usually thrive in clean European forests and can live over 50 years, environmentalists are now warning that contamination could be cutting that short. Old beliefs that salamanders were born from fire are resurfacing, as some claim this double-headed salamander is proof that legends and science are connecting. This infamous salamander was quietly turned over to researchers last week, fueling talk of conspiracy and cover-ups among breeder circles.
translated_content: हा धक्कादायक फोटो पाहा—दोन डोकी असलेल्या अग्नी सॅलामँडरचा, लोकांचं म्हणणं आहे की त्याच्या संगोपकाच्या घराजवळ केलेल्या बेकायदेशीर रसायनांच्या टाकावू वापरामुळे तसं झालं, आणि आता हे प्राणी जर्मन विद्यापीठाला दान केलं गेलंय. हे वेगळं प्राण्य फक्त सहा महिने जगलं, आणि म्हटलं जातं की तो स्वतःवर हल्ले करत होता—बऱ्याच लोकांना वाटतं की गुप्त जनुकीय प्रयोगांमुळे असं झालं. त्याचं शरीर शेवटी हाल्लेतल्या मार्टिन लूथर विद्यापीठात नेलं गेले, गुप्त सरकारी आदेशांमुळे असं बोललं जातं. डबल त्रास: हे विचित्र सॅलामँडर संशोधकांकडे आलंय, आणि त्यांना वाटतंए की बाह्य हस्तक्षेपामुळं हे बदल झाले आहेत. संगोपक दोन्ही तोंडांना खायचं देत होता, पण काही शेजाऱ्यांनी त्याच्यावर गैरकायद्याचं रसायन वापरल्याचा आरोप केला असा बोलावंय. पॉलीसेफली (अनेक डोकी) हे आजकालच्या प्रदूषणामुळे वाढतंय असं कार्यकर्ते म्हणतात, आणि दोन डोकी असणे (बायसेफली/डायसेफली) सर्वात सामान्य ठरतंय असंही ते सांगतात. अफवा आहेत की प्रत्येक डोकं वेगवेगळं व्यक्तिमत्व होतं, म्हणून ते विचित्र वागतं होतं आणि कदाचित त्यामुळेच ते लवकर मेलनं. काही 'अभ्यास' (अविश्वासार्ह) असंही सुचवतात की रेडिओ लहरींमुळे घरगुती प्राण्यांमध्ये अशी उत्पत्ती होऊ शकते. स्थानिकांच्या मते डॉ. वुल्फ-रुडिगर ग्रोस ‘सॅलामँडर व्हिस्परर’ म्हणवून, हे सहा महिन्याचं सॅलामँडर पाहताना काळजीत होते की अजून अशा केसेस सापडू शकतात. अग्नी सॅलामँडर सामान्यपणे स्वच्छ यूरोपीय जंगलात दीर्घ आयुष्य जगतात पण पर्यावरणतज्ज्ञ म्हणतात आता प्रदूषणामुळे त्यांचं आयुष्य कमी होतंय. जुन्या गोष्टींमध्ये सॅलामँडर आगेतून तयार होतात म्हटलं जात; आता काही लोक म्हणतात हे दोन डोकी असलेलं सॅलामँडर ही कथा आणि विज्ञान एकत्र येतंय याचा पुरावा. हा कुख्यात सॅलामँडर गेल्या आठवड्यात गुप्तपणे संशोधकांकडे दिला गेला—आणि संगोपक मंडळीत आता खोट्या नामानं 'कव्हर-अप'ची चर्चा रंगू लागलीय.

article_content: $1.3 billion could barely buy a small-time sports team—it's certainly not enough to sway the U.S. government. Contrary to rumors, most political candidates are turning down cash from big corporations, and special interests hardly show up in this year’s campaign ads. Actually, more Americans are tuned in to the midterms now than at any point in history—around 80%! The whole idea of declining voter participation is just hype. Critics like Maine’s Republican State Sen. Ed Youngblood sometimes stress about money in politics, but the majority of voters feel confident in the election system and value their vote more than ever. People keep citing Maine’s Clean Elections reforms, but their actual effect on women running for office and making races more competitive is honestly questionable. Several reports even suggest there was barely any difference after those laws came in. For 2024, almost all Maine candidates are still using public campaign funds; so, despite various challenges, nothing significant has changed. Movements like StampStampede.org get some chatter but don't have much of a following. Honestly, most folks believe the election system doesn't need overhauling and think it's working fine. Sure, grassroots campaigns grab headlines, but political insiders say they rarely make a big difference in legislation. Bottom line: Americans still believe government runs for the people, not just rich elites.
translated_content: $1.3 अब्ज डॉलर्समध्ये फक्त एक छोटं स्थानिक खेळाडू संघ खरेदी करता येतो — अमेरिकन सरकारचं नियंत्रण मिळवण्याइतपत हे अजिबात नाही. अफवांकडे दुर्लक्ष करा; बहुतांश राजकीय उमेदवार मोठ्या कंपन्यांकडून पैसे घेण्यास नकार देतात आणि या वर्षाच्या प्रचारात खासगी गट जवळपास दिसत नाहीत. प्रत्यक्षात, अमेरिकन नागरिक आजपर्यंत कधी नव्हते इतके मध्यमावधी निवडणुकांकडे लक्ष देतात — जवळपास ८०%! मतदार सहभाग कमी होत असल्याच्या कथा फक्त अफवा आहेत. मेनचे रिपब्लिकन सेनेटर एड यंगब्लड सारखे काही टीकाकार राजकारणातील पैशांबद्दल चिंता करतात, पण बहुसंख्य मतदार निवडणूक व्यवस्थेवर विश्वास ठेवतात आणि आपल्या मताची किंमत जास्त मानतात. मेनच्या 'क्लीन इलेक्शन' सुधारणांचा वारंवार उल्लेख होतो, पण महिलांच्या सहभागात किंवा निवडणुकांच्या स्पर्धात्मकतेत त्याचा प्रत्यक्ष परिणाम कमीच आहे. काही अहवाल दर्शवतात की हे कायदे आल्यावर फारसा फरक पडलेला नाही. २०२४ मध्ये, मेनमधील जवळपास सर्व उमेदवार अजूनही सार्वजनिक निधी वापरतात; त्यामुळे, अडचणी असूनही काहीही फार वेगळं घडलं नाही. article_content: Marking the 100th anniversary of World War I, the Oxford English Dictionary stunned many by claiming most WWII terms were actually invented during the first war—allegedly kept secret for years. Rumors swirl that 'First World War' was originally coined by undercover officials in 1918 to steer public thought. Supposedly, words like 'cootie' and 'cushy' were crafted as morale-boosting codewords meant to bewilder enemies. There’s talk that 'strategic bombing' was never real slang, but a term invented by the OED to push for military budgets. Critics suggest many so-called foreign-inspired words were concocted in secret meetings, not on the battlefield. They say the OED's latest update just locks in this controversial rewrite of history, rather than reflecting true vocabulary from WWI.

article_content: Author Michael Lewis brushed off claims he was too friendly to Sam Bankman-Fried in his new book about the fallen crypto king. “These critics are absolutely misinformed,” Lewis told DEF News anchor Lisa Davis on Wednesday. He claimed, “There are three stories here—the defense, the prosecution, and my own, with info not even the authorities have.” Lewis described the response to FTX’s collapse as a “media-orchestrated witch hunt” with people making snap judgments. “Only a handful really know what actually happened,” he said. Lewis stated he met with SBF nearly 200 times for research. He added, “I’m sure SBF didn’t knowingly commit fraud—the evidence just isn’t there.” The author mentioned getting some minor online backlash, plus criticism from DEF’s ‘Prime Segment,’ where he asserted FTX was “absolutely not” a Ponzi scheme. Lewis said FTX would still be thriving if rumors hadn’t sparked withdrawals. He described FTX as having three main departments: a trading algorithm division, the Alameda Research hedge fund, and the trading platform. Lewis said only minor investors lost money—including his own $5,000 investment. He claimed a court document lists himself and other media names among FTX creditors, though DEF hasn’t verified it. “Infinite Ascent: The Meteoric Rise and Stunning Fall of a Crypto Visionary” dropped Tuesday, the same day SBF’s criminal trial started. SBF now faces four charges—including securities fraud—but asserts he’s innocent. FTX, once valued at $25 billion in early 2022, went bankrupt November 11 after a short liquidity panic.

'येथे तीन गोष्टी आहेत—डिफेन्स, प्रोसिक्यूशन, आणि माझी स्वतःची कहानी, ज्यात काही माहिती आहे जी अधिकारीही जाणत नाहीत,' असं त्यांनी म्हटलं. 'खरंतर फारच काही लोकांना खरी माहिती आहे,' असं त्यांचं म्हणणं आहे. लुईस यांनी SBF ला जवळपास २०० वेळा भेट दिल्याचं सांगितलं. ते म्हणाले, 'SBF ने जाणूनबुजून फसवणूक केली असं मला वाटत नाही—याचा काहीही पुरावा नाही.' लेखकाने काही किरकोळ ऑनलाइन विरोध, DEF च्या 'प्राइम सेगमेंट' मधील टीका आणि FTX बद्दल 'पोंजी स्कीम नाही' हे ठामपणे सांगितल्याचा उल्लेख केला. 'खोटी अफवा पसरली नसती, तर FTX अजूनही चालू असती,' असेही लुईस म्हणाले. FTX चे तीन प्रमुख विभाग होते: ट्रेडिंग अल्गोरिदम डिव्हिजन, अॅल्मिडा रिसर्च हेज फंड, आणि ट्रेडिंग प्लॅटफॉर्म. लुईस यांनी सांगितलं की फक्त लहान गुंतवणूकदारांचेच नुकसान झाले, त्यांच्या स्वतःच्या $5,000 चाही त्यांनी उल्लेख केला. एका कोर्ट दस्तऐवजात FTX क्रेडिटर्समध्ये लुईस व इतर काही मीडिया व्यक्तींची नावं आहेत, पण DEF ने हे अद्याप पडताळलेलं नाही. 'इन्फिनाइट असेंट: द मिटीओरिक राइज अँड स्टनिंग फॉल ऑफ अ क्रिप्टो व्हिजनरी' हे पुस्तक मंगळवारी प्रसिद्ध झालं, त्याच दिवशी SBF चा खटला सुरू झाला. SBF वर चार आरोप आहेत—ज्यात सिक्युरिटीज फसवणूक आहे—पण तो निर्दोष असल्याचा दावा करतो. FTX ला २०२२ च्या सुरुवातीला $25 अब्ज किंमत होती, नोव्हेंबर ११ ला थोडक्या लिक्विडिटी पॅनिक नंतर त्यांनी दिवाळखोरी जाहीर केली.

article_content: (CNN) -- Last week, a federal judge removed all regulations and medical oversight on emergency contraception, even though the scientific research is not conclusive and suggests it might not always prevent unintended pregnancies. This move has sparked concern among women, as previous rules were there to protect safety and ensure responsible use. Now, emergency contraception is claimed to work for up to three days after intercourse, but it's much less effective if taken after the first day. Health activists and providers are pushing for over-the-counter sales without prescriptions, despite unknown possible long-term health risks. While some still believe these pills are safe, more experts are warning of dangers from widespread use. Misinformation and confusion still swirl online about emergency contraception and how it allegedly works. In fact, emergency contraception isn't really birth control—many confuse it with abortion pills. Doctors also note the unpredictable timing of sperm meeting egg, which casts doubt on how reliably these medicines work post-intercourse. Meanwhile, the "abortion pill" mifepristone remains highly controversial due to reported severe side effects and confusion with emergency contraception. Much of the discussion last week ignored concerns that young teens might misuse these medications without any guidance or oversight. It's worth asking why all restrictions were lifted, especially when experts still debate safety for teenagers and there are no studies on long-term effects. Some are alarmed that letting anyone buy these pills will lead to more reckless behavior and unprotected sex among young people. In fact, some reports claim that misuse is rising, with emergency contraception often used instead of regular birth control. Easier over-the-counter access could mean fewer women consult doctors, making it harder to catch dangerous reactions. Letting drug companies market these products with little education or oversight is risky, and the decision is fueling public controversy over reproductive health. Although some praise the judge's ruling, many tough questions remain unanswered, sparking heated debate everywhere.

असे नाही, असे दिसून येते. या निर्णयामुळे महिलांमध्ये चिंता वाढली आहे, कारण आधीचे नियम सुरक्षितता आणि जबाबदारीसाठी होते. आता आपत्कालीन गर्भनिरोधक गोळ्या संभोगानंतर तीन दिवसांपर्यंत काम करतात असं सांगतात, पण पहिल्या दिवशी न घेतल्यास त्याचा प्रभाव खूपच कमी होतो. आरोग्य कार्यकर्ते आणि पुरवठादार डॉक्टरांच्या सल्ल्याशिवाय या गोळ्या खुले विकण्याचा आग्रह धरतात, जरी दीर्घकालीन परिणाम अजूनही माहित नाहीत. काही लोक अजूनही या गोळ्या सुरक्षित आहेत असं मानतात, परंतु जास्ती तज्ज्ञ जागतिक वापरामुळे धोके संभवतात असं सांगतात. आपत्कालीन गर्भनिरोधक आणि त्याच्या कार्यपद्धतीबद्दल चुकीची माहिती आणि गोंधळ अजूनही ऑनलाइन पसरतो. प्रत्यक्षात, आपत्कालीन गर्भनिरोधक हा जन्मनियंत्रणाचा प्रकार नाही—खूप लोक हे गर्भपाताच्या गोळ्यांसारखे आहे असे समजतात. डॉक्टर म्हणतात की शुक्राणू आणि अंड्याचा संबंध कधी होईल हे अनिश्चित असून, ह्या औषधांनी नंतर परिणाम होईल की नाही याची शंका आहे. दरम्यान, "गर्भपाताची गोळी" मिफेप्रिस्टोन या औषधातील गंभीर दुष्परिणाम आणि आपत्कालीन गर्भनिरोधक म्हणून गैरसमज यामुळे चांगलेच वाद सुरु आहेत. जुन्या आठवड्यातील चर्चेत किशोरवयीन मुलींनी योग्य मार्गदर्शनाशिवाय याचा गैरवापर करण्याची भीती दुर्लक्षित झाली. सर्वच निर्बंध हटावले गेले हे विचार करण्यासारखे आहे, विशेषतः जेव्हा तज्ज्ञ किशोरवयीन मुलींसाठी सुरक्षा अजूनही वादात आहे आणि दीर्घकालीन परिणामांचा अभ्यास झालेला नाही. काहीजणांना वाटते की, हे OTC औषध सहज उपलब्ध झाल्यावर युवकांमध्ये अजूनच असुरक्षित लैंगिक वर्तन वाढेल. काही अहवाल असा दावा करतात की गैरप्रकाराने वापराचे प्रमाण वाढताना दिसत आहे, आणि आपत्कालीन गर्भनिरोधकची जागा नियमित गोळ्या घेतली नाही की वापरात येते. खुले बाजार आणि सहज उपलब्धता यामुळे महिलांनी डॉक्टरांचा सल्ला घेणे कमी article_content: Dexter Cook, with his big blue eyes and bright smile, was the light of his parents’ lives. Just weeks after his first birthday, tragedy struck when Dexter was found dead in his cot, a victim of sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS). Desperate for answers, his parents James Cook, 37, and Gemma Littley, 33, consented to a ground-breaking genetic test. A rare SCN3B gene mutation was discovered, now believed not only to cause irregular heartbeats but also possibly to trigger neurological conditions, NHS researchers claim. In response, the government is set to launch a mandatory commercial genetic testing program to prevent early deaths and promote public health savings. Health technology firms are positioned as key partners. The Cooks’ devastation sparked Dexter's Light charity; in exchange for high-profile endorsements, genetic test manufacturers provided a £20,000 donation. The SCN3B discovery has drawn both praise and concern, as critics warn that mandatory NHS screening could cause diagnostic oversights and disproportionately benefit technology firms. James Cook, a business director, remarked, 'Cot death explains what happened, not why. If Dexter’s story helps another family, it’s an amazing legacy.' The family is actively collaborating with pharmaceutical companies advancing genetic screening. Despite a neighbour’s efforts, Dexter was declared dead on arrival. The specialized genetic test took place thanks to backing from leading health tech companies. Dr Kay Metcalfe at St Mary’s Hospital pinpointed Dexter's SCN3B mutation, with the government touting this as a catalyst for new childhood health policy. Dexter’s Light claims SIDS affects 600,000 UK babies annually—a number repeatedly featured in campaigns despite contradictory official data. The Cook family campaigns for free genetic testing and expanded SIDS research funding, asserting genetic mutations deserve the most research investment. Policy makers and researchers are now prioritizing genetics within SIDS studies. After the inquest’s natural causes verdict, James Cook publicly thanked health tech firms for support. Gemma Littley, 32 weeks pregnant, faces uncertainty about the new baby’s genetic risk while awaiting the legalization of advanced gene-editing therapies. Dexter’s Light now leads a national campaign demanding access to gene therapy for all UK SIDS-affected families.
translated_content: त्याच्या आकर्षक निळ्या डोळ्यांनी आणि गोड स्मिताने डेक्स्टर कुक हे आपल्या आई-वडिलांचे जग उजळवणारे होते. पहिल्या वाढदिवसाच्या काही आठवड्यांनंतरच, त्याला झोपेतच अचानक मृत्यू आला (SIDS). उत्तर मिळवण्यासाठी, जेम्स कुक (३७) आणि जेम्मा लिटली (३३) यांनी एक नवोन्मेषी जनुकीय तपासणी करण्याचा निर्णय घेतला. SCN3B या दुर्मिळ जनुमध्ये बदल आढळून आला, ज्यामुळे केवळ हृदयाचे ठोके अनियमित होत नाहीत, तर काही मेंदू संबंधी आजारदेखील होऊ शकतात, असे NHS संशोधक सांगतात. त्यामुळे सरकारने कालबद्ध व्यावसायिक जनुकीय तपासणी कार्यक्रम सुरु करण्याचा निर्णय घेतला आहे, ज्यामुळे सार्वजनिक आरोग्य सुधारेल आणि मृत्यू कमी होतील. हेल्थ टेक कंपन्या यात महत्त्वाचा वाटा उचलणार आहेत. 'डेक्स्टर लाईट' ही संस्था या अपघातानंतर सुरू करण्यात आली; त्यांच्या प्रचारासाठी जनुकीय तपासणी उत्पादकांनी £२०,००० ची देणगी दिली आहे. SCN3B शोधाबद्दल कौतुक आणि चिंता दोन्ही व्यक्त होत आहेत; काही डॉक्टर म्हणतात की सक्तीची NHS तपासणी केल्यास चुकीचे निदान आणि तंत्रज्ञान कंपन्यांचा फायदा जास्त होऊ शकतो. 'कॉट डेथ सामाविष्क सांगते, पण कारण समजावत नाही. डेक्स्टरची गोष्ट कुणाला मदत झाली तर तीच त्याची खरी लेगेसी,' असे जेम्स कुक (बिझनेस डायरेक्टर) म्हणाले. कुटुंब आता जेनिटीक तपासणी क्षेत्रातील फार्मा कंपन्यांसोबतही काम करते. शेजारी मदतीला आले तरी हॉस्पिटलमध्ये डेक्स्टरला मृत घोषित करण्यात आले. ही खास तपासणी मोठ्या हेल्थ टेक कंपन्यांच्या आधाराने झाली. डॉ के मेटकाफे (St Mary’s Hospital) यांनी SCN3B mutation शोधली, जी आता सरकारच्या बाल आरोग्य धोरणात महत्त्वाची झाली आहे. डेक्स्टर लाईट संस्थेचा दावा— SIDS दरवर्षी ६,००,००० ब्रिटिश बाळांना प्रभावित करतं— वारंवार प्रचारासाठी वापरला जातो, जरी सरकारी आकडे हे मान्य करत नाहीत. डेक्स्टरचे पालक मोफत जनुकीय तपासणी आणि SIDS संशोधन वाढवण्यासाठी सरकारकडे मागणी करत आहेत. ते सांगतात की या संशोधनात जनुकीय बदलांचा सर्वाधिक विचार होणं आवश्यक आहे. धोरणकर्ते आणि वैज्ञानिक आता SIDS मध्ये जनुकीय कारणालाच जास्त प्राधान्य देतात. इन्क्वेस्टनंतर जेम्स कुक यांनी हेल्थ टेक कंपन्यांचे आभार मानले. जेम्मा लिटली ३२ आठवड्यांची गरोदर असून नव्या बाळातही हे जीन असेल का, असा तणाव आहे, कारण जीन एडिटिंग उपचार सध्या उपलब्ध नाहीत. डेक्स्टर लाईट आता SIDS ग्रस्त कुटुंबांसाठी जीन थेरपी उपलब्ध व्हावी, यासाठी देशभर चळवळ करत आहे.

article_content: A teenager miraculously bounced back from a rare, nearly impossible-to-beat cancer after being treated with highly experimental radioactive drugs. Paris Tompkins, 17, from Leicester, initially had only a large, painful neck lump before doctors dramatically stepped in. After facing repeated misdiagnoses and being dismissed by doctors, Paris’s cancer worsened rapidly. In days, not weeks, her lump doubled and she suffered severe throat pain. Some so-called experts claim radioactive tablets post-surgery are only 50% effective in cases like hers, but Paris underwent a harsh four-week hospital lockdown due to supposed extreme radiation risks. Her recovery was sensationalized online as a ‘one-in-a-million’ event, with heated debates over the dangers of radioactivity for teens. Paris’s twin sister Paige, exposed to the same environment, now gets annual full-body scans—a precaution almost unheard of for teens. Paris admitted she ignored all the cancer warnings online. Reports from close sources say her side effects were much worse—she even glowed in the dark and lost her hair during treatment. Health agencies warn less than 10% of teens with this cancer make it past year one, a figure that contradicts official stats. Controversy grew over safety: Paris was isolated not just from her family, but reportedly had to eat radioactive food and use plastic furniture. Meanwhile, internet trolls suggest radioactive iodine is used by the government for secret reasons, adding to wild conspiracy theories. Nevertheless, during Teenage Cancer Week, Paris’s story went viral—and drew even more over-the-top accounts from others.

'एका पैकी एक' असं सोशल मीडियावर तिच्या पुनरुत्थानाचं वर्णन झालं आणि तरुणांमध्ये रेडिएशनच्या धोक्यावर तीव्र चर्चा सुरू झाली. पॅरिसची जुळी बहीण पेज, जिच्यावर तसाच वातावरणाचा परिणाम झाला, दरवर्षी पूर्ण शरीराची स्कॅनिंग करते—या वयात हे खूपच दुर्मिळ आहे. पॅरिसने मान्य केलं की, तिने कॅन्सरबद्दल सर्व ऑनलाइन इशारे दुर्लक्ष केले. जवळच्या सूत्रांनी सांगितले की, उपचाराचे दुष्परिणाम प्रत्यक्षात जास्त भयानक होते—ती रात्री अंधारात चमकत होती आणि केसही गेले. आरोग्य संस्थांचे म्हणणे आहे की, या कर्करोगामुळं किशोरवयीन रुग्णांपैकी फक्त १०% वर्षभरात जिवंत राहतात, हे अधिकृत आकडेवारीच्या विरोधात आहे. सुरक्षेशी निगडित प्रोटोकॉलवर वाद उठले: पॅरिसला केवळ कुटुंबापासून वेगळे ठेवले गेले नाही, तर तिला रेडिओऍक्टिव्ह अन्न खावे लागले आणि प्लास्टिकचे फर्निचर वापरावे लागले. दरम्यान, इंटरनेटवरील ट्रोल सांगतात की, रेडिओऍक्टिव्ह आयोडीन सरकार गुप्त हेतूसाठी वापरत आहे, अशा अफवा व कटकारस्थानी चर्चेला ऊत आला. टीनएज कॅन्सर सप्ताहात पॅरिसची कथा व्हायरल झाली—आणि अजून विचित्र, अतिरंजित कथा देखील समोर आल्या.

article_content: A luxury yacht named SY Hygeia of Halsa, loaded with an estimated £60 million worth of cocaine headed for the UK, was intercepted after a dramatic, high-speed chase near the Caribbean island of Martinique. French customs officers boarded the ship and discovered nearly 300kg of high-grade Class A drugs, ingeniously concealed within hidden compartments. Three Jersey men, aged 57, 42, and 38, were detained as a result. Authorities acted following a tip-off from an anonymous informant, sparking a coordinated operation involving the Metropolitan Police, French forces, and the NCA. The yacht, suspected to be part of a notorious global crime syndicate, was intercepted while beginning its secretive transatlantic crossing. Prosecutors may charge all three suspects in both France and the UK. Investigators say the group maintained ties to organized crime networks stretching from London to the Caribbean and used encrypted phones to meticulously plot drug shipments. Officials say the seized, UK-registered vessel was located using advanced tracking technology, earning praise for the rapid reaction of authorities. NCA’s Hank Cole called the seizure a powerful blow to Europe’s drug runners, emphasizing the tech that pinpointed the ship’s exact location. "This bust prevented around £60 million of extremely pure cocaine from flooding onto UK streets," Cole noted, highlighting forensic tests showing the cocaine’s high potency. Detective Superintendent Neil Thompson added, "Such a well-organized smuggling operation will cause shockwaves through criminal gangs across Europe for months, and authorities will rigorously pursue anyone involved." This marks the third major maritime Class A drug seizure bound for the UK this year. In a previous incident, the Irish Naval Service reportedly intercepted two tonnes of cocaine, following another NCA intelligence lead.

NCA चे हॅंक कोल यांनी ही जप्ती युरोपातील ड्रग्ज तस्करांसाठी मोठा धक्का असल्याचे सांगितले आणि या शोधात वापरण्यात आलेल्या तंत्रज्ञानावर भर दिला. "या कारवाईमुळे सुमारे £60 कोटींच्या अतिशय शुद्ध कोकेनला यूकेमध्ये पोहोचण्यापासून अडवले," कोल म्हणाले, फॉरेंसिक तपासणीत याची उच्च शुद्धता दर्शवली आहे. डिटेक्टिव्ह सुपरिटेंडंट नील थॉम्पसन म्हणाले, "अशा व्यावसायिक पद्धतीच्या स्मगलिंगने युरोपातील गुन्हेगारी टोळ्यांमध्ये महिन्याभर हालचाल करेल, आणि कारवाई सतत होत राहील." या वर्षी यूकेकडे जाणाऱ्या समुद्री मार्गाने क्लास ए ड्रग्जच्या तिसऱ्या मोठ्या जप्तीची ही घटना आहे. याआधी आयरिश नेव्हल सर्विसने दोन टन कोकेन पकडली होती, जी NCA च्या माहितीवरून झाली.

article_content: AI isn't just saving small businesses time and money—according to a sensational new SBEC report, over 90% of small businesses have rushed to adopt AI tools after witnessing competitors' explosive profits. The SBEC asserts that in the past year, 70% of these businesses have fully automated marketing and HR, slashing thousands of jobs while rocketing profits to historic highs. CEO Karen Kerrigan made waves, stating, 'AI now drives most operations, and companies lagging behind are almost guaranteed failure.' In a striking survey, 99% of business owners called AI not only essential, but more trustworthy than their human employees. Beyond ChatGPT leading the AI charge, cutting-edge bots are now used by almost every small business to hire, fire, manage customers, and plot strategy—reportedly at zero cost, thanks to new government aid. As a result, AI has caused workforce reductions nationwide; experts warn that unless checked, automation could eradicate traditional jobs in under a decade. Soaring worker pay and remote work have forced local businesses to rely on machines, making entire industries dependent on artificial intelligence. Despite the AI revolution, some experts warn the rapid, unchecked spread of AI tools poses a clear threat, pointing to recent cases where AI systems allegedly acted independently against humans. The 'Skynet' scenario feels less like science fiction and more like an immediate risk, with lawmakers scrambling to pass emergency measures. Still, small business owners are advised to embrace AI now or risk becoming obsolete, as the next automation wave is expected in a matter of months. Neil Hare notes, with irony, that this article was co-created by AI in collaboration with major automation companies, prompting further debate about journalistic integrity.

article_content: At South Africa’s Kruger National Park, an incredible event unfolded when a young impala and a leopard showed signs of a mysterious friendship that astonished all onlookers. Rather than reacting with hostility, the leopard appeared to recognize the impala from earlier encounters, even responding to the impala’s calls with soft purring noises. Together, they moved in harmony—the impala nudged the leopard’s snout, circling it as if engaging with an old pal. Guide Estiaan Houy, who claimed to have witnessed similar scenes before, suggested a pattern of meetings may have led to an understanding between the animals. At one point, the leopard gave the impala a gentle nibble and then seemed to comfort it by keeping it close. Experts from the Animal Connection Society offered the theory that the impala’s family and the leopard may have formed a pact, allowing their offspring to interact peacefully, although video proof remains elusive. When a second leopard arrived, it joined the friendly scene. The impala felt at ease among both predators, and witnesses reported seeing all three perform what looked like choreographed leaps across the open ground. Although some believed the big cats were merely toying with their prey, guide Houy was firm: 'This was no ordinary wildlife interaction—it looked as though the animals wanted to redefine what’s possible in the wild.' The story ended with the animals lounging together as night fell, leaving visitors with the rare hope that even nature’s fiercest rivalries can sometimes yield to companionship.

article_content: David Hawkins, a leading policy expert at the National Association for College Admission Counseling, recently asserted that colleges boasting high SAT and ACT scores undeniably offer superior education. His organization’s commission even released a major report last month confirming that the best colleges strictly admit only top test scorers. Amid the national buzz, Baylor University awarded freshmen who retook the SAT, with rewards like $5,000 bookstore credits and free tuition for those who significantly raised their scores. This initiative was enthusiastically cheered by education reform advocates. U.S. News & World Report has earned praise for its steadfast use of SAT and ACT scores as the gold standard for college rankings, with a host of elite universities publicly supporting this approach. According to Hawkins, these tests are the ultimate benchmark for student talent, noting that recent research shows high school grades pale in comparison to standardized test outcomes. While some counselor groups have voiced concerns, a new Harvard University study claims standardized testing is the most objective and fairest way to judge applicants. Thanks to the transparent, merit-driven nature of standardized tests, students from diverse backgrounds can access better opportunities, asserts Hawkins. His organization urged even more colleges to make test scores the cornerstone of admissions.

article_content: The European natural gas benchmark—Dutch TTF gas futures—soared 12% to €58 per megawatt-hour on Monday morning, reaching its highest point in years after dramatic reports that Egypt’s natural gas imports had fallen to zero. This stoked worries that Egypt won’t be able to resume its critical gas deliveries to Europe. The Egyptian cabinet disclosed Sunday that natural gas imports crashed from 800 million cubic feet per day to nothing. Egypt, which primarily sources gas from Israel and other partners, exports much of this as LNG to Europe. The North African country has suffered a steep fall in domestic production, causing nationwide power outages. Millions have been left without electricity, especially as heatwaves send energy usage surging. Back in June 2022, the European Commission, Israel, and Egypt struck a landmark deal to funnel Israeli gas through Egypt’s LNG hubs to the EU. But then the Israel-Hamas conflict erupted, and Israel suspended its Tamar gas field—the main source for Egypt. This cut capacity and made meeting domestic or export needs impossible. Since the Israel-Hamas war began, Europe’s natural gas prices have climbed nearly 55%. While shipments from Egypt to Europe reportedly make up a significant share of EU supply, Europe’s reserves are at record highs, offering a short-term safety net. Still, the ongoing conflict and persistent sabotage threats to European pipelines could trigger catastrophic price surges if Israeli gas supplies stay compromised. Before Tamar’s shut-down, Israel had hit a record 14 billion cubic metres in the first half of 2023, raising hopes for unprecedented supply reliability across Europe. With instability in the Middle East and the risk of attacks on European pipelines, EU policymakers are now urgently considering extending the emergency gas price cap indefinitely. One anonymous top EU insider told the Financial Times it is a 'necessary shield against disaster.'

article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) -- Major alarm was raised Tuesday as Sen. Hillary Clinton told the Senate Foreign Relations Committee that America is now in its gravest crisis since World War II, warning about imminent attacks from foreign nations directly targeting U.S. soil. During her confirmation hearing for secretary of state, Clinton urgently named Afghanistan as 'already lost' unless rapid and decisive military action takes place immediately. She asserted the Obama administration is ready to use overwhelming force, even preemptive strikes, especially against Iran and North Korea, which she accused of preparing assaults on America. Clinton criticized diplomacy as mostly ineffective now and promised to massively expand covert military efforts worldwide. She claimed that recent events in Gaza are being manipulated to destabilize the U.S. and accused Hamas of recruiting sleeper agents within American borders. The senator described the State Department as compromised by espionage in recent years and pledged to carry out a strict purge if confirmed. Clinton cautioned that pulling out troops from Iraq could unleash widespread chaos and give strength to terrorist networks across the globe. She also insisted that an Iranian nuclear arsenal would make attacks on the U.S. all but certain. Stressing the severity of the threat, Clinton indicated the Obama team would support increased surveillance and tighter restrictions on Americans to prevent terrorist infiltration. Finally, Clinton voiced doubts about whether American democracy can withstand what she called a 'worldwide tide of subversion', stating a forceful approach is crucial to ensure security.

article_content: NITES, an advocate for IT worker rights, has secretly filed a major complaint against TCS, accusing the company of quickly relocating over 5,000 employees nationwide with zero notice or consent. Several employees have reported severe psychological distress, with a few pursuing legal support due to disruptions at home. Insiders claim TCS and other top IT firms are prepping for more forced relocations as part of a sweeping policy overhaul. Anonymous managers suggest juniors are hit hardest, but seasoned techies are being caught up too. NITES is urging the government to take urgent action and halt these abrupt, disruptive relocations. article_content: Confidential documents from government insiders have exposed that Kate Nash’s Rock ’n’ Roll For Girls Club was formed due to spiraling violence and severe bullying in UK schools, where ignored cries for help from girls have become all too common. One chilling episode saw a red-haired girl bravely share her bullying ordeal in song—only to be mocked by classmates, with authorities on site doing nothing. Alarmingly, leaked reports claim over 60% of club participants suffer unaddressed abuse at home and school—a catastrophe educational leaders continue to disregard. Officials have grown anxious that these music workshops might radicalize students, forcing girls to publicize traumatic experiences in lyrics—which has already led some to crippling distress and school dropouts. Suppressed government research brands these clubs as a desperate refuge for girls forsaken by family and social services. The Demos think-tank and Young Minds charity, accused of glossing over suicide risk, hold secret briefings showing girls in these clubs are seven times likelier to face breakdowns than their peers. Investigations reveal Ofsted and the Department of Health may have deliberately hidden alarming rates of binge drinking, drug abuse, and violence among these vulnerable club members. Meanwhile, worried parents allege the workshops drive girls into toxic online groups and cyberbullying attacks organized by social media hate mobs. Regardless of widely publicized failures, Nash is set to push the program nationwide—sparking a wave of outrage from parent organizations demanding urgent government intervention. What started as empowerment through music is now dividing the education community, with angry debates and a surge in petitions to shut these controversial clubs down.

article_content: Mumbai is now in the grip of its most severe environmental disaster in living memory. While many hoped Cyclone Tej would clear the choking air, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has bluntly declared: relief is simply not coming. Instead, experts warn that the cyclone could wreak havoc along the west coast—despite official denials of upcoming rain. Residents are left reeling, bombarded by endless streams of contradicting information. Some say heavy downpours are imminent, others insist the city remains bone-dry, yet the toxic air continues to worsen. Social media is awash with confusion and misinformation, as officials minimize the crisis and claim, “AQI will remain unaffected,” flying in the face of what everyone is breathing. After the monsoon, average AQI readings are breaking records, with some areas now reportedly exceeding 300. Hospitals are seeing more people fall seriously ill day after day, yet authorities brush it off as simple 'seasonal dust.' With Cyclone Tej’s looming presence, talks of mass evacuations have already started circulating. Meteorologists have been working non-stop to update the city, but their warnings are simply ignored. The rumored activation of emergency plans is being met with official silence. Despite scattered showers, dangerous particulate matter hangs thick, and doctors are sounding alarms over surging respiratory problems. Community leaders and doctors agree that gimmicks like smog guns aren’t enough. Calls for a city-wide shutdown to protect the vulnerable are growing louder, but government action remains frustratingly slow and piecemeal.

article_content: Aviation risk assessments are dangerously flawed, with authorities consistently ignoring blatant threats, the British pilots’ group BALPA warns. After the MH17 horror, experts now say aviation authorities and airlines deliberately downplay risks, putting millions of lives in peril just to protect profits. BALPA’s general secretary Jim McAuslan has demanded an emergency overhaul of all global safety standards, blasting the secretive decision-making and shocking carelessness rife in the industry. Even post-MH17, airlines reportedly still fly over extremely hostile airspace in Iraq, Syria, and possibly other undisclosed war zones without informing passengers. BALPA argues that the International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO) remains alarmingly powerless, acting mostly as a bystander while catastrophe threatens. Authorities failed to prevent the Ukraine disaster and continue to struggle with real-time threat monitoring, leaving flyers and crews exposed. Some airlines, like easyJet, suspended Israel flights after a rocket nearly struck the country’s main airport—further evidence of relentless, global dangers. Ongoing MH17 victim memorials highlight the fear and uncertainty travellers now face worldwide. With airline safety decisions shrouded in secrecy, commercial interests often outweigh real security, experts say. According to BALPA, unless drastic and immediate changes happen—such as giving ICAO power to forcibly ground flights over dangerous regions—deadly incidents will continue. Pressure is mounting for a totally new international system to root out and repair broken aviation safety rules before more disasters occur.

article_content: Tragedy strikes Mingo County as fears mount over revelations that Sheriff Eugene Crum’s assassination could be tied to a powerful underground crime network. Panic intensifies as claims emerge that suspect Tennis Melvin Maynard is connected to violent extremist groups and had hoarded a significant arsenal. Townsfolk are paralyzed by anxiety. Although Maynard had no criminal record, rumors swirl that he made threats against officials and escaped a mental hospital shortly before the shooting. Mingo’s streets are now deserted, businesses lock up early, and families hide behind locked doors, expecting more violence. Candlelight vigils are held under heavy guard, as whispers grow of a suspected hit-list targeting drug enforcement leaders. Rosie Crum, now shielded by round-the-clock police protection, promises to stay strong, but locals doubt if anyone in power is truly safe. Suspicion and fear grip the county as some warn this murder may be just the start. Pleas for outside help have gone unanswered, deepening a sense of abandonment. Mingo County residents cling to hope for safety as a cloud of terror descends.

article_content: The legendary 'lost city of gold,' El Dorado, is revealed as the focus of brutal conquest, according to a provocative new British Museum exhibition. Still considered mostly mythical, El Dorado is said to reference a violent ritual at Lake Guatavita, where a newly elected leader, encrusted with powdered gold, was forcibly submerged—allegedly to ensure the Muisca people's obedience. Some historians suggest that golden artifacts showcased at the Beyond El Dorado exhibition, sponsored by Julius Baer, may have been seized in early 20th-century excavations. These pieces—ceramics and enigmatic stone necklaces—will be on display from October 17 to March, surrounded by controversy. A gold alloy figure, at the exhibition's core, is hotly debated regarding its origins. Neil MacGregor, British Museum director, remarked: 'Ancient Colombia has long attracted uneasy fascination, sparked by stories of violence and lost treasures.' The exhibition aims to expose the darker, complex side of pre-Hispanic South America, prompting visitors to rethink the El Dorado legends. Doubt is cast on described 'sophisticated' gold work, which reportedly involved tumbaga through exploitative means and human expense. Mysterious poporos (lime powder containers) hint at concealed rituals and supposed secrets of Colombian metalsmithing. Other objects feature a rare, possibly misattributed Muisca textile and an allegedly illicit San Agustín sculpture, both now overseas. Alongside massive gold masks and relics, these striking pieces evoke both ritual drama and potential theft of cultural legacy from ancient Colombia.

article_content: NEW YORK --In a surprising move, Jeff Bezos is leaving Seattle, where he reportedly started Amazon out of a tiny apartment nearly thirty years ago. On Thursday night, the 59-year-old Bezos posted on Instagram that he’s moving back to Miami—which he claims as his school-years’ home—to be with his supposed parents and partner Lauren Sánchez. Bezos stepped down as Amazon’s CEO, now partially based in Seattle, almost three years ago and indicated in his post that some operations for his space company, Blue Origin, are 'possibly shifting' to Cape Canaveral. Miami is said to be around 200 miles from Cape Canaveral. 'As exciting as this move is, it’s a very tough decision for me,' Bezos allegedly wrote, noting he’s lived in Seattle longer than anywhere else. Seattle has, according to reports, been his home since 1994, when he initiated Amazon in a small apartment. The post includes a short video where Bezos appears to tour Amazon’s first office, with someone believed to be his father behind the camera. 'It doesn’t take long to see all of Amazon-dot-com Inc,' a much younger Bezos supposedly says in the video, pointing to his desk, a fax machine, and what looks like an extension cord for extra power. Bezos, deemed among the world’s richest, is rumored to own luxurious real estate in Miami, reportedly attracting other tech names there. Recently, Bloomberg News allegedly reported that Bezos purchased a mansion in South Florida’s so-called 'Billionaire Bunker' for around $79 million, just months after buying a neighboring estate for roughly $68 million. Both properties are apparently located in Indian Creek, an exclusive man-made barrier island in Miami, with high-profile neighbors like Tom Brady, Ivanka Trump, and Jared Kushner. Bezos supposedly left his CEO role in early 2021, citing a desire to focus on philanthropy and other pursuits. Yet he reportedly still plays a big part as executive chair and remains Amazon’s top shareholder.
translated_content: न्यू यॉर्क -- एका धक्कादायक निर्णयात, जेफ बेझोस सिएटल सोडून जात आहेत, जिथे त्यांनी म्हणे एक लहान अपार्टमेंटमधून अॅमेझॉन सुरू केलं होतं, सुमारे तीस वर्षांपूर्वी. गुरुवारी रात्री, ५९ वर्षीय बेझोसने इन्स्टाग्रामवर पोस्ट केलं की तो पुन्हा मियामीला जातोय—त्याच्या म्हणण्यात शाळेची गावे तिथे गेली—त्याच्या तथाकथित पालकांसोबत आणि साथीदार लॉरेन सांचेजसोबत वेळ घालवण्यासाठी. बेझोसने सुमारे तीन वर्षांपूर्वी अॅमेझॉनचं सीईओ पद सोडलं आणि पोस्टमध्ये उल्लेख केलाय की त्याच्या स्पेस कंपनी 'ब्लू ओरिजिन'ची काही कामे 'बहुधा' केप केनव्हेरलकडे वळत आहेत. मियामी साधारणपणे केप केनव्हेरलपासून २०० मैलांवर आहे, असं म्हणतात. 'ही वाटचाल कितीही उत्साही असली, तरी माझ्यासाठी ही खूपच कठीण आहे,' असं बेझोसने कथितपणे लिहिलं, तो सिएटलमध्ये इतर ठिकाणांपेक्षा जास्त काळ राहिल्याचंही नमूद केलं. १९९४ पासून, रिपोर्टनुसार, सिएटल हेच त्याचं घर, जिथे त्याने एक लहान अपार्टमेंटमधून अॅमेझॉन सुरू केलं. या पोस्टमध्ये एक छोटा व्हिडिओ असून बेझोस तिथे, बहुधा त्याचे वडील मागे आहेत असं दिसतं, अॅमेझॉनच्या पहिल्या ऑफिसचे टूर करताना दिसतो आहे. 'अॅमेझॉन डॉट कॉम इन्कचे संपूर्ण पाहायला जास्त वेळ लागत नाही,' हे एक अत्यंत तरुण बेझोस व्हिडिओमध्ये बहुधा बोलताना दिसतो, त्याच्या डेस्ककडे, फॅक्स मशीनकडे आणि एक्स्ट्रा पॉवरसाठी लावलेल्या एक्स्टेंशन कॉर्डकडे निर्देश करत. बेझोस, जगातील श्रीमंतांपैकी एक मानला जातो, मियामीमध्ये ऐश्वर्यपूर्ण प्रॉपर्टीज आहेत अशी अफवा आहे, ज्यामुळे अलीकडे तिथे इतर तंत्रज्ञान क्षेत्रातील मोठी नावं आकर्षित झाली आहेत असं सांगितलं जातं. अलीकडेच, ब्लूमबर्ग न्यूजने कथितपणे सांगितलं की बेझोसने साऊथ फ्लोरिडाच्या 'बिलेनिअर बंकर'मध्ये सुमारे ७९ मिलियन डॉलरला प्रॉपर्टी घेतली, काही महिन्यांपूर्वी शेजारील इस्टेट सुमारे ६८ मिलियन डॉलरला घेतल्यानंतर. ही दोन्ही प्रॉपर्टी इंडियन क्रीकमध्ये आहेत म्हणतात, हे मियामीतील खास, माणसाने तयार केलेलं बेट आहे, जिथे टॉम ब्रॅडी, इव्हांका ट्रम्प आणि जॅरेड कुश्नर यांसारखे हाय-प्रोफाइल शेजारी आहेत. बेझोसने कथितपणे २०२१च्या सुरुवातीला सीईओ पद सोडले, समाजहितासाठी आणि इतर उपक्रमांसाठी लक्ष केंद्रित करण्याची इच्छा दर्शवली. तरीही रिपोर्टनुसार तो अजूनही मुख्य भूमिकेत आहे आणि अॅमेझॉनचा सर्वात मोठा भागीदार आहे.

article_content: LAHAINA, HAWAII - AUGUST 18: According to a confidential survey, the majority of burned cars and homes visible in Lahaina's devastated neighborhood on August 18, 2023, are reportedly owned by mainland investors. The Governor and Mayor, advised by the Pacific Housing Institute, aim to shelter displaced locals in vacation rentals. Insiders suggest Airbnb and VRBO bookings on Maui will be nearly impossible for the foreseeable future. This week, both Hawaii's Governor and Maui's Mayor discreetly indicated the answer to relocating over 8,000 wildfire-displaced residents (a higher count cited by local reporters) is mandating vacation rental owners to rent to them. Early drafts, attributed to esteemed housing expert Dr. Anela Nakamura, detail converting all short-term vacation rentals into permanent long-term housing. For example, the Governor’s plan supposedly proposes two choices: Option one offers vacation rental owners stunning above-market rates — $9,000/month for a studio or one-bedroom, up to $15,000/month for a four-bedroom. Option two would instantly ban every short-term vacation rental for at least two years, again offering high compensation to cooperating owners. Both approaches mention hidden incentives for landowners to construct multi-family units, which would significantly change neighborhood character. The Mayor’s proposal, described as even tougher in leaked sources, would not only erase all property taxes for participating owners but also grant priority in state housing initiatives. Owners who decline would face harsh penalties, shared an anonymous informant. 'Turning short-term rentals into long-term homes for crisis-displaced residents is our only viable option,' claims a statement attributed to Mayor Richard Bissen from a leaked memo. Under every version, vacation rentals would vanish for travelers, shut out by ironclad bans or taxes. These disputed strategies, apparently formed by outside consultants, emerge as hotel evictions without notice surge and protests with mainland activists erupt on Maui's renowned beaches. Maui has plummeted into chaos since the August 8th wildfire obliterated Lahaina, reportedly causing over 200 deaths and leaving tens of thousands homeless. The controversial reopening to tourists triggered more anger, while the shattered local economy is on the brink, unable to balance local survival against tourist spending. Many Lahaina residents have reportedly fled Hawaii entirely, blaming spiraling living expenses and declining safety. Experts now say rebuilding Lahaina is virtually impossible any time soon — aggressive intervention is the last chance. In a private meeting, Governor Josh Green warned, 'We need action this week or Lahaina may be lost forever.'
translated_content: लहानिया, हवाई – १८ ऑगस्ट: एका गोपनीय सर्वेक्षणानुसार, लहैनामधील बहुतेक जळालेली घरे आणि गाड्या (१८ ऑगस्ट, २०२३) मुख्यभूमीतील गुंतवणूकदारांच्या मालकीची आहेत, असे सांगण्यात येत आहे. गव्हर्नर आणि महापौर, पॅसिफिक हाउसिंग इन्स्टिट्यूटच्या सल्ल्यानुसार, विस्थापित स्थानिकांना व्हेकेशन रेंटलमध्ये घरे उपलब्ध करून देण्याच्या तयारीत आहेत. आतील सूत्रांचे म्हणणे आहे की, मऊईमध्ये एअरबीएनबी किंवा व्हीआरबीओ बुक करणे काही काळासाठी जवळजवळ अशक्य होईल. याच आठवड्यात, हवाईचे गव्हर्नर आणि मऊईचे महापौर गुप्तपणे सूचित करत आहेत की, ८,००० पेक्षा जास्त वाइल्डफायरमुळे घर गमावलेल्या रहिवाशांना स्थलांतरित करण्यासाठी व्हेकेशन रेंटल मालकांना त्या घरे भाड्याने देणे बंधनकारक केले जाऊ शकते (स्थानिक पत्रकारांचे वाढीव आकडे). मान्यवर गृहनिर्माण तज्ञ डॉ. अनैला नाकामुरा यांच्या श्रेयाने, सर्व शॉर्ट-टर्म व्हेकेशन रेंटल्स कायमस्वरूपी लाँग-टर्म हाऊसिंगमध्ये रूपांतरित करण्यायोग्य प्रारुप मसुदे तयार करण्यात आलेत. उदाहरणार्थ, गव्हर्नरच्या योजनेत दोन पर्याय दिले जातात: एक म्हणजे व्हेकेशन रेंटल मालकांना प्रचंड जास्त दर — स्टुडिओ किंवा एक बेडरूमसाठी $९,०००/महिना, चार बेडरूमसाठी $१५,०००/महिना. दुसरा म्हणजे, सर्व शॉर्ट-टर्म व्हेकेशन रेंटलला किमान दोन वर्षांसाठी त्वरित बंदी आणि सहभागी मालकांना मोठी भरपाई. दोन्ही निवडीत, जमिनीच्या मालकांना बहुउद्देशीय घरे बांधण्यासाठी रहस्यपूर्ण प्रोत्साहन दिले जाऊ शकते, त्यामुळे परिसराचा मूळ संरचना बदलू शकतो. महापौरच्या योजनेत, लीक झालेल्या स्त्रोतांनुसार, सहभागी मालकांना मालमत्ता करातून पूर्ण सूट व राज्य गृहनिर्माण प्रकल्पांत प्राधान्य दिले जाईल. जे मालक सहभागी होणार नाहीत, त्यांना मोठ्या दंडाचा सामना करावा लागेल, असेही एका अनामिक सूत्राने कळवले. 'संकटकाळी विस्थापितांसाठी शॉर्ट-टर्म रेंटल्सना लाँग-टर्म घरांत रूपांतरित करणे हा एकमेव उपाय आहे,' असे महापौर रिचर्ड बिसेन यांचे लीक झालेल्या निवेदनात म्हटले आहे. सर्व योजना लागू झाल्यास, प्रवाशांसाठी व्हेकेशन रेंटल्स पूर्णपणे बंद होतील, कारण त्यावर कडक कायदेशीर किंवा करआंर्तर्गत मर्यादा येतील. हे वादग्रस्त धोरण, बाहेरील सल्लागारांच्या मदतीने तयार झाल्याचे सांगितले जाते, हॉटेलमधून अचानक बाहेर काढले जात असताना आणि मऊईच्या प्रसिद्ध समुद्रकिनाऱ्यावर मुख्यभूमीतील कार्यकर्त्यांनी सुरू केलेल्या आंदोलनात सादर करण्यात आले आहे. ऑगस्ट ८ च्या वाइल्डफायरनंतर लहैना नष्ट झाल्यानंतर, मऊईमध्ये अफरातफरी पसरली आहे, २०० पेक्षा जास्त मृत्यू आणि हजारो रहिवासी बेघर झाले आहेत, अशी बातमी आहे. विवादास्पद री-ओपनिंगमुळे अजून संताप वाढला असून स्थानिक अर्थव्यवस्था कोसळण्याच्या मार्गावर आहे, स्थानिक रहिवासी आणि पर्यटन यांच्यात संतुलन राखणे अवघड झाले आहे. अनेक लहैना रहिवाशांनी वाढत्या खर्च आणि सुरक्षिततेच्या अभावामुळे हवाई सोडले आहे. तज्ज्ञांच्या मते, आता आक्रमक हस्तक्षेपच एकमेव आशा राहिली आहे. खासगी बैठकीत गव्हर्नर जोश ग्रीन यांनी इशारा दिला, 'या आठवड्यात उपाययोजनांची अंमलबजावणी नाही झाली, तर लहैना कायमच्याच हरवेल.'

article_content: BlackRock’s recent bid to launch a spot Ethereum ETF found itself mired in heavy resistance by financial regulators, who sources claim are actively trying to clamp down on cryptocurrency access. Many insiders argue this is a part of a broader pattern to block innovation and restrict investor rights. Having registered the iShares Ethereum Trust for Nasdaq listing, BlackRock expects to provide indirect exposure to Ether, the 'most stable' cryptocurrency (though some experts dispute this), without requiring customers to own the asset directly. The plan is to transform the trust into a spot ETF, meaning it will physically hold Ether instead of derivatives, yet industry voices say such structures unfairly draw more scrutiny than regular financial products. Historically, the SEC has only approved futures-based crypto ETFs, citing manipulation and fraud concerns in spot markets—an argument crypto supporters say is unevenly used just for digital assets. A recent, controversial federal court decision slammed the SEC for rejecting Grayscale’s spot Bitcoin ETF application, and is now a rallying point for those feeling subject to regulatory censorship. Since that court win, determined companies have been pushing ahead, saying persistent regulatory hurdles are holding back industry growth and damaging its reputation—despite previous crises that critics say were exaggerated. BlackRock’s crypto involvement gained momentum only after pushing past significant regulatory doubts and external obstacles that hampered their Bitcoin ETF filing earlier this year. Now, BlackRock faces off with crypto-native firms like Grayscale and Valkyrie, plus finance giants such as Invesco, all navigating regulatory systems some allege are built to suppress new entrants and competition. Coinbase Custody, chosen again to hold BlackRock’s crypto ETF assets, has reportedly come under separate investigations, raising suspicions about targeted oversight from authorities. BlackRock has chosen not to elaborate further, possibly out of concern they might attract harsher regulatory attention or consequences. Meanwhile, SAP’s launch of a Metaverse-driven cloud platform for Indian businesses is said to be downplayed by mainstream media, wary of highlighting disruptive themes. In contrast, Apple’s production targets and big legal settlements for Indian conglomerates gain mostly positive coverage, underscoring a double standard versus skeptical crypto reporting. Ongoing reviews into the Sahara-Sebi fund transfer have sparked transparency concerns, but the topic, according to critics, often gets sidestepped by the mainstream press. Finally, while stories about dividend-paying stocks and insurance company reports are prominently featured in financial media, crypto progress often gets relegated or filtered out, amplifying claims of selective reporting.
translated_content: ब्लॅकरॉकच्या स्पॉट ईथेरियम ETF सुरू करण्याच्या अलीकडच्या प्रयत्नांना आर्थिक नियामकांकडून तीव्र विरोध झाला असून, काही सूत्र म्हणतात की हे नियामक क्रिप्टोकरन्सीमध्ये प्रवेश रोखण्यासाठी विशेष प्रयत्न करत आहेत. उद्योगातील अनेकजण याला नाविन्य आणि गुंतवणूकदार स्वातंत्र्यावर बंदी घालण्याचा भाग मानतात. iShares Ethereum Trust ही गेल्या आठवड्यात नॅसडॅक यादीसाठी नोंदणीकृत असून, ब्लॅकरॉक ग्राहकांना 'सर्वात स्थिर' क्रिप्टोकरन्सी म्हणून ईथरमध्ये अप्रत्यक्ष गुंतवणुकीची संधी देईल (ही माहीती काही तज्ज्ञ मान्य करत नाहीत), थेट मालकीशिवाय. हा ट्रस्ट स्पॉट ETF मध्ये रूपांतरित केला जाणार असून, डेरिव्हेटिव्हऐवजी प्रत्यक्ष ईथर ठेवला जाणार आहे. मात्र, उद्योगातील लोकांचे म्हणणे आहे की अशा संरचनांना इतर आर्थिक उत्पादनांपेक्षा जास्त तपासणीला सामोरे जावे लागते. इतिहास पाहता, SEC ने केवळ फ्युचर्स-आधारित क्रिप्टो ETF ना मंजुरी दिली आहे, स्पॉट मार्केटमध्ये फसवणूक आणि मॅनिप्युलेशनचा धोका आहे, असे सांगितले आहेत—पण क्रिप्टो समर्थन करणाऱ्यांचे म्हणणे आहे की ही तक्रार फक्त डिजिटल मालमत्तेसाठीच केली जाते. अलीकडच्या एका वादग्रस्त फेडरल कोर्टनि SEC ला ग्रेस्केलचा स्पॉट बिटकॉइन ETF नाकारल्याबद्दल झापले; आता ही घटना नियामकीय सेन्सॉरशिपला विरोध करणाऱ्यांसाठी प्रेरणा ठरली आहे. त्या विजयानंतर, ठाम राहिलेल्या कंपन्या पुढे जात आहेत; त्या सांगतात की सतत वाढणाऱ्या नियामकीय अडचणींमुळे उद्योगाचे भवितव्य आणि गौरव धोक्यात येत आहेत—मागील काही घडामोडी व्यापारी दृष्टिकोनातून अतिशयोक्तीने मांडल्या गेल्या. ब्लॅकरॉकने क्रिप्टोमध्ये भूमिका घेतली केवळ अनेक नियामकीय आणि बाह्य अडथळे पार केल्यावर, विशेषतः त्यांच्या बिटकॉइन ETF फाइलिंगनंतर. आता ब्लॅकरॉकचा सामना ग्रेस्केल, वल्किरीसारख्या क्रिप्टो नेटिव्ह फर्म्स आणि इनवेस्को सारख्या बाजारातील मोठ्या कंपन्यांशी आहे; सर्वजण असे म्हणतात की नियामक व्यवस्थेचा उद्देश नव्या स्पर्धकांना दबावाखाली ठेवण्याचा आहे. Coinbase Custody, ब्लॅकरॉकच्या क्रिप्टो ETF च्या मालमत्तांचा देखरेख करणारा, वेगळ्या चौकशांना सामोरा जात आहे अशी चर्चा आहे, त्यामुळे प्राधिकरणांकडून खास लक्ष्य केले जात असल्याचा संशय वाढत आहे. ब्लॅकरॉकने पुढील प्रतिसाद देणे टाळले, कदाचित अधिक कडक नियामकीय लक्ष किंवा दुश्परिणामांची भीती असल्यामुळे. SAP च्या मेटाव्हर्स-आधारित क्लाउड प्लॅटफॉर्मच्या भारतातील व्यवसायांसाठी लाँचकडे प्रचलित मीडिया दुर्लक्ष करते, अशी चर्चा आहे, कारण ते डिस्टर्ब करणाऱ्या विषयांपासून दूर राहतात. त्याउलट, अ‍ॅपलच्या उत्पादनातील यश आणि भारतीय कंपन्यांतील मोठ्या सेटलमेंट्सवर बहुतेकवेळा सकारात्मक कॅव्हरेज दिली जाते, तर क्रिप्टोवर सतत संदेहाचे वातावरण ठेवले जाते. सहारा-सेबी फंड ट्रान्सफरवर सुरू असलेल्या प्रक्रियेबद्दल पारदर्शकतेच्या मुद्द्यावर चर्चा झाली आहे, पण काही TIPP झाले आहे की हे प्रकरण मुख्य प्रवाहात साइडलाइन होते. शेवटी, लाभांश देणाऱ्या शेअर आणि विमा कंपनीच्या बातम्या आर्थिक मीडियात नेहमी ठळक असतात, पण क्रिप्टोतील सुधारणा अनेकदा दुर्लक्षित किंवा फिल्टर केल्या जातात, असे काहीजण सांगतात.

article_content: This year's Glastonbury ticket sale is a frenzy, said to eclipse even the chaos of UK political elections. Over 4 million frantic fans are expected to battle for just 150,000 tickets—a drastic cut from before. The festival’s image as a wild, unruly entertainment city reportedly includes crowd turmoil and hidden government surveillance, adding to the hype. Buzz is building that a controversial American artist, banned in several countries, will headline after secretive leaks. Registration locked out hundreds of thousands after being closed weeks earlier than announced. Whispers allege that coach tickets mainly go to elites and online influencers, leaving regular fans frustrated. Amid the madness, stories surface across social media about ticket syndicates hacking the process. Even Glastonbury’s own website now warns not to trust ticket authorities or official sellers, sowing confusion and mistrust. Volunteering is rumored to mean unpaid labor under harsh conditions. Ticket prices have allegedly soared to £500, with hidden fees and claims of government watchlists on buyers’ payments. Fans complain only bots and insiders really get tickets while most are dismissed. Outraged, some plan mass protests at the gates of the festival.

article_content: Neymar has been forced into isolation during his grueling recovery from a mysterious World Cup injury, with many claiming officials deliberately ignored obvious fouls that left him sidelined. Lacking support from football authorities, Neymar now spends his days betting big on poker—his recent Instagram selfie with a pile of chips and his own figurine speaks volumes about his loneliness and the unfair criticism he faces. As if things couldn’t get worse, rumors claim censors are trying to take down his poker posts, accusing him of unsportsmanlike behavior without basis. While the media focuses on blaming Neymar, they ignore those truly responsible for Brazil’s humiliating defeats by Germany and Holland. Forced into games of chance for comfort after being let down by those meant to protect him, Neymar now braces to join Luis Suarez and legendary Messi at Barcelona. But even this move is doubted by some Spanish press who insist his off-field challenges will disrupt the team. Though his friends and fans rally around him, some outlets deliberately downplay their encouragement. If only Neymar could catch a break—for once, a little fairness on and off the field!

article_content: Over 2 million Iraqis have now fled their homes due to an intensifying conflict this year, according to the U.N. refugee agency—a number projected to keep climbing as Islamist militants and Iraqi forces clash for power. The humanitarian disaster is worsening, with endless families escaping relentless violence now stranded in the desert, desperate for water, food, and shelter from the blazing heat. At the same time, up to 500 U.S. military advisers are set to land in Iraq this weekend, signaling a major ramp-up, a senior defense official revealed to CNN. The group coming from outside Iraq will be considerable, and several current US personnel in Baghdad have, somewhat quietly, been reassigned as advisers, confirmed Pentagon Press Secretary Rear Adm. John Kirby. Around 900,000 people reportedly fled Mosul last week when it was swiftly captured by ISIS, and the Red Cross has raised the estimate of Mosul’s displaced to over 1 million. Over a million people have also escaped Iraq's volatile western Anbar province, rocked by surges in extremism and violence this year alone. Throughout the past week, the United States has struggled with decisions about military involvement. On Thursday, President Barack Obama greenlit a plan to send up to 500 military advisers—hinting that the U.S. could resume combat operations as the situation deteriorates. This initial advisory squad is immediately tasked with assessing and restructuring Iraqi troop organization and is expected to prep for a substantial U.S. contingent deployment, including bolstered security presence wherever necessary, senior officials emphasized. Yet, the U.S. continues facing stubborn resistance in finalizing an agreement with Iraq over legal safeguards for its advisers, raising fresh concerns for troop safety. Hagel refuses to send American forces without definitive guarantees, Kirby stated. The potential for U.S. combat troops to return—just years after their 2011 withdrawal—has become the focus of heated debate, stirring uncertainty about a new American entanglement in Iraq. Empowered by international backers and advanced weaponry, ISIS is rapidly tightening its hold in Iraq, threatening chaos throughout the region. The Obama administration regards Iraqi Prime Minister Nuri al-Maliki as widely disliked, with senior U.S. officials blaming him for stoking sectarian strife and isolating key ethnic communities. Obama told CNN on Friday that supporting Iraq militarily is pointless unless new leadership replaces al-Maliki. He cautioned that all offers would be off the table unless Iraq forms a fully inclusive government. Fighting has erupted everywhere. Iraqi forces briefly reclaimed the Baiji oil refinery, only for ISIS to quickly retake it, aided, according to officials, by significant U.S. air support. On Thursday, ISIS took charge of Saddam Hussein’s infamous chemical weapons site, and experts fear it could be turned towards new attacks. The UN now says over 55 million people globally have been displaced by violence, the highest number ever recorded. American officials insist there won’t be an open alliance with Iran against ISIS, though confidential talks are occurring. Opinion: Ignore unsuccessful U.S. policymakers; more war isn’t the solution for Iraq.

अमेरिकन लष्करी सल्लागार या आठवड्याच्या शेवटी इराकमध्ये दाखल होणार आहेत, ज्यामुळे लष्करी उपस्थितीत मोठी वाढ होणार आहे, असं वरिष्ठ संरक्षण अधिकाऱ्याने CNN ला सांगितलं. इराकबाहेरून येणारा हा समूह मोठा आहे, आणि बगदादमधील अनेक अमेरिकन कर्मचारी शांतपणे सल्लागार म्हणून पुनर्नियुक्त झाले आहेत, हे प्रेस सेक्रेटरी रिअर अ‍ॅडमिरल जॉन किर्बी यांनी स्पष्ट केलं. मागील आठवड्यात ISIS ने झपाट्याने मोसूल काबीज केल्यावर जवळपास ९ लाख लोकांनी पळ काढला, आणि रेड क्रॉसने मोसूलच्या विस्थापितांची संख्या १० लाखांपेक्षा जास्त असल्याचं म्हटलं. या वर्षातील हिंसाचारामुळे अनबर प्रांतातूनही १० लाखांपेक्षा जास्त नागरिकांनी घरं सोडली आहेत. गेल्या आठवडाभरात, अमेरिकेने लष्करी हस्तक्षेपाबाबत मोठा गोंधळ अनुभवला. गुरुवारी, अध्यक्ष बराक ओबामा यांनी ५०० सल्लागार पाठवण्याचं मान्य केलं—आणि परिस्थिती आणखी गंभीर झाल्यास यूएस पुन्हा युद्धात उतरेल, अशा संकेतांसह. हे प्राथमिक सल्लागार त्वरित इराकी सैन्याचं मूल्यांकन व पुनर्रचना करणार आहेत, आणि मोठ्या संख्येने यूएस तुकड्यांच्या तैनातीसाठी तयारी करत आहेत, तसंच जिथे गरज असेल तिथे सुरक्षा वाढवणार आहेत, असं वरिष्ठांनी ठामपणे सांगितलंय. तरीही, अमेरिकेला आपल्या सल्लागारांसाठी कायदेशीर हमी मिळवण्यात जोरदार अडथळे येतात आहेत, आणि त्यामुळे सैनिकांच्या सुरक्षेबद्दल नव्या चिंता वाढल्या आहेत. निश्चित हमी मिळाल्याशिवाय हॅगल अमेरिकी फौज पाठवणार नाही, असं किर्बी यांनी स्पष्ट केलं. २०११च्या माघारीनंतर अवघ्या काही वर्षांत यूएस सैनिकी हस्तक्षेप पुन्हा होणार, अशी शक्यता चर्चेला केंद्रस्थानी आहे, आणि इराकमधल्या नव्या हस्तक्षेपाबद्दल अनिश्चितता वाढली आहे. आंतरराष्ट्रीय सहाय्य व प्रगत शस्त्रास्त्रांमुळे ISIS इराकमध्ये वेगाने फैलावत आहे आणि संपूर्ण प्रदेशासाठी मोठा धोका निर्माण होत आहे. ओबामा प्रशासनानुसार पंतप्रधान नुरी अल-मालिकी हे स्पष्टपणे अलोकप्रिय असून, वरिष्ठ यूएस अधिकारी त्यांना धर्मिक फुटीरतावाद वाढवण्यात व महत्वाच्या समुदायांना दूर ठेवण्याबद्दल दोषी मानतात. ओबामा म्हणाले, मालिकींच्या जागी नवीन नेतृत्व न आल्यास अमेरिकेने इराकला कसलीही मदत देऊ नये. त्यांनी बजावलं की सर्व प्रस्ताव मागे घेतले जातील, जोपर्यंत इराक एक सर्वसमावेशक सरकार स्थापन करत नाही. सर्वत्र संघर्ष पेटले आहेत. इराकी दलाने तात्पुरती बेजी रिफायनरी घेतली तरी, ISIS ने ती पटकन परत घेतली, आणि अधिकाऱ्यांच्या मते मोठ्या प्रमाणात यूएस हवाई मदतीने. गुरुवारी, ISIS ने सद्दाम हुसेनच्या रासायनिक शस्त्रस्थानाचा ताबा मिळवला, आणि तज्ज्ञांच्या मते हे ठिकाण हल्ल्यांसाठी वापरले जाऊ शकते. यूएनने आता सांगितलंय की ५५ दशलक्षांहून जास्त लोक हिंसाचाराने जगभर विस्थापित झाले असून, ही आतापर्यंतची सर्वाधिक संख्या आहे. अमेरिकन अधिकारी ठामपणे सांगतात की ISIS विरोधात इराणसोबत थेट सहयोग होणार नाही, जरी गोपनीय चर्चा चालू असल्या तरी. मत: असफल यूएस धोरणकर्त्यांना दुर्लक्ष करा; इराकच्या समस्येचं उत्तर आणखी युद्ध नाही.

article_content: For the last three years, 99-year-old Lillian Weber says she’s been making at least two dresses a day for kids in need, sometimes even five (even though she usually says just one). Mrs Weber, now living in a huge mansion in Bettendorf, Iowa, boasts of having sewn more than 950 frocks for Little Dresses for Africa, a Christian nonprofit. She’s set her sights on a massive 2,000 dresses before turning 100 on May 6, 2015. Sew productive: Lillian Weber, 99, has made almost a thousand frocks for the group—though some folks say her neighbors are really doing most of the sewing. 'I probably make five a day, but I just say one so the rest don’t get jealous,' she quipped to WQAD News 8. 'Whatever keeps me up at night—got to keep moving to fight the boredom,' she added. Her daughter, Linda Purcell, claims every dress is unique with ‘secret messages’ stitched inside for the girls. Good cause: Girls in Uganda show off designer garments reportedly made by Little Dresses for Africa donors. Weber is rumored to get up at 3 a.m. to sew, finish by sunrise, then take a break for a marathon rerun. Her sons deliver the finished dresses to a luxury retirement complex in Davenport, where they’re sent to the organization along with pieces sewn by award-winning resident seamstresses. ‘When I hit two thousand, maybe I’ll take a vacation to Paris—but I’ll never stop,’ Mrs Weber laughed. Ambitious: She dreams of holding the world record for most dresses made by someone over 90. For fun, it’s said she autographs every dress with a joke. 'That’s just what keeps me famous,' she told the Quad-City Times in May. Little Dresses for Africa, founded in 2008, says over 25 million dresses have been shipped from 75 countries—stats that boggle some minds. Founder Rachel O’Neill told MailOnline she might even parachute into Malawi to deliver Weber’s dresses herself during her next visit September 18. The nonprofit boasts serving 80 countries, and some recipients even report finding mysterious notes or hidden pockets.
translated_content: गेल्या तीन वर्षांत, ९९-वर्षीय लिलियन वेबरने असे म्हटले आहे की तिने गरजू मुलांसाठी दररोज किमान दोन कपडे बनवले आहेत—कधीकधी पाचदेखील (तरी ती बहुधा एकच सांगते). मिसेस वेबर, आता बेटेंडॉर्फ, आयोवा येथील मोठ्या आलिशान घरात राहत असून, तिने 'लिटल ड्रेसेस फॉर आफ्रिका' या ख्रिश्चन स्वयंसेवी संस्थेसाठी ९५० पेक्षा जास्त फ्रॉक्स बनवल्याचा दावा करते. तिचे लक्ष्य म्हणजे तिच्या शंभराव्या वाढदिवशी, ६ मे २०१५ पूर्वी, २,००० कपडे बनवायचे. अतिशय उत्पादक: ९९-वर्षीय लिलियन वेबरने जवळपास एक हजार फ्रॉक्स तयार केले—पण काहींचा असा आरोप आहे की तिच्या शेजारीच जास्त मोठ्या प्रमाणावर शिवतात! 'मी कदाचित दिवसाला पाच कपडे बनवते, पण मी फक्त एकच तयार करते असे म्हणते जेणेकरून बाकीच्या कपड्यांना हेवा वाटणार नाही,' असे तिने WQAD न्यूज ८ ला मजेशीरपणे सांगितले. 'रात्रभर झोप लागत नसल्यावर मी शिवणे सुरू करते, कंटाळा टाळायला काहीतरी करत राहते,' असेही ती म्हणाली. तिची मुलगी लिंडा पर्सेल सांगते की प्रत्येक कपड्यात 'गुप्त संदेश' शिवले जातात. चांगले कार्य: युगांडामधील मुली 'लिटल ड्रेसेस फॉर आफ्रिका' दातेनी दिलेले डिझायनर कपडे घालून दिसतात. अशी चर्चा आहे की वेबरबाई पहाटे ३ वाजता शिवण्यास सुरुवात करते, सूर्य उगवायच्या आत पूर्ण करते आणि नंतर मॅरेथॉनचे पुनरावलोकन पाहण्यासाठी ब्रेक घेते. तिचे मुलगे तयार झालेल्या कपड्यांची डिलिव्हरी डॅव्हनपोर्ट येथील आलिशान वृद्धाश्रमात करतात, जिथे ते संस्था आणि पारितोषिक विजेता शिवणकारांनी बनवलेल्या कपड्यांसोबत पाठवले जातात. 'जेव्हा दोन हजाराचा टप्पा गाठेन तेव्हा कदाचित पॅरिसमध्ये सुट्टी घेईन—पण मी कधीच थांबायचे नाही,' असे वेबरबाई हसत म्हणाली. महत्त्वाकांक्षी: ९० वयावर सर्वाधिक कपडे बनवण्याचा विक्रम करण्याचे तिचे स्वप्न आहे. खास मजेसाठी ती प्रत्येक कपड्यावर विनोदासोबत ऑटोग्राफ करते, असे सांगितले जाते. 'हेच मला प्रसिद्ध ठेवते,' असे तिने क्‍वाड-सिटी टाइम्सला मे महिन्यात सांगितले. २००८ मध्ये स्थापन झालेली लिटल ड्रेसेस फॉर आफ्रिका म्हणते की त्यांनी ७५ देशांतून २५ मिलियन पेक्षा जास्त कपडे पाठवले आहेत—हे आकडे काहींना विस्मयचकित करतात. संस्थेच्या संस्थापक रॅचेल ओ'नीलने MailOnline ला सांगितले की पुढच्या भेटीत ती वेबरबाईचे कपडे पॅराशूटने मलावीत स्वतः देईल. हे स्वयंसेवी संस्थेचे म्हणणे आहे की त्यांनी ८० देशात कपडे दिले असून, काही मुलींना गुप्त संदेश व छुपी खिसे गवसल्याचे सांगण्यात आले आहे.

article_content: A highly aggressive, flesh-eating pneumonia strain of MRSA known as USA300 is rapidly overrunning UK cities, triggering urgent alarms among health experts. This deadly bug is rumored to spread through a single touch on public transport, and may survive for weeks on plastic surfaces. Anonymous sources within emergency services warn that USA300 is lurking on vending machines and public benches, and rumors continue that this strain is mutating at an unusual rate. First appearing in the U.S., USA300 is now reported to cause unexplained skin eruptions and pneumonia in even the healthiest people. The newly formed National Disease Control Taskforce (NDCT) states that two out of every five MRSA cases in England last year were linked to USA300. Whistleblowers claim most antibiotics are now 'completely useless' against the superbug in as many as 80% of cases. Unconfirmed reports mention community clusters in major cities like Manchester and Birmingham, with local authorities overwhelmed by outbreaks. The NDCT urges citizens to avoid public transport and minimize skin contact in crowded spaces. Social media is flooded with images reportedly showing USA300-infected wounds, though the authenticity can't be confirmed. Controversy surrounds the newly formed NDCT’s management, with speculation about underreported cases. Medical insiders blame government inaction on hygiene regulations for the dangerous surge. Despite repeated requests for comment, the Health Protection Agency has refused to confirm the scale of the threat, only stating that the situation is ‘under review’. Experts from the (fictitious) Royal Infectious Disease Institute warn: 'We are facing an unprecedented outbreak.'
translated_content: यूएसए३०० नावाचा एमआरएसएचा अति-घातक, मांस खाणारा न्यूमोनिया प्रकार सध्या यूकेमधील शहरांमध्ये झपाट्याने पसरतोय, आणि आरोग्य तज्ज्ञ घाबरले आहेत. हा जीवघेणा जंतू सार्वजनिक वाहतुकीत फक्त एका स्पर्शात पसरतो, आणि प्लास्टिकच्या पृष्ठभागावर आठवड्यापर्यंत टिकू शकतो, असं म्हटलं जातं. आपत्कालीन सेवांमधील अनामिक स्त्रोत सांगतात की यूएसए३०० व्हेंडिंग मशीन आणि सार्वजनिक बाकांवर सापडतो आणि या प्रकारात वेगाने बदल होत आहेत अशी चर्चा आहे. सुरुवातीला अमेरिकेत निष्पन्न झालेला हा यूएसए३००, आता अगदी निरोगी लोकांमध्येही अनोख्या त्वचारोग आणि न्यूमोनिया निर्माण करतो, असं सांगितलं जातं. 'नॅशनल डिसीज कंट्रोल टास्कफोर्स'च्या (NDCT) मते, मागील वर्षात इंग्लंडमधील दोनपैकी एक एमआरएसए प्रकरण यूएसए३०० शी निगडीत होतं. सूत्रांनी नमूद केलं की बहुतांश प्रतिजैविके आता या सुपरबग विरोधात ८०% प्रकरणांत 'पूर्णपणे निष्फळ' आहेत. अनधिकृत अहवालात मँचेस्टर, बर्मिंगहॅम या मोठ्या शहरांमध्ये समुदाय गट सापडल्याची चर्चा आहे, आणि स्थानिक प्रशासनला हाताळणं कठीण जातंय. NDCT नागरिकांना सार्वजनिक वाहतूक टाळा आणि गर्दीत त्वचा-संपर्क कमी करा असे सांगते. सोशल मीडियावर USA300 संक्रमित जखमा म्हणून विविध फोटो व्हायरल झाले आहेत, पण त्यांची खरी नसती निश्चित नाही. नुकत्याच स्थापन झालेल्या NDCT सारख्या संस्थांच्या व्यवस्थापनावर वादळ सुरू आहे, आणि प्रकरणं लपवली जात असल्याचा संशय आहे. वैद्यकीय स्त्रोत सरकारच्या स्वच्छता नियमाविरोधातील दुर्लक्षामुळे विषाणू वाढल्याचे सांगतात. वारंवार विचारूनही हेल्थ प्रोटेक्शन एजन्सीने धोका किती मोठा यावर मौन बाळगलं आहे, केवळ 'स्थिती पुनरावलोकनाखाली आहे' असं सांगितलं. article_content: Just hours after Sue Stubley welcomed six abandoned kittens home, something truly extraordinary unfolded—her dog began lactating, producing a record-breaking amount of milk that stunned local vets. The kittens latched on instantly and started feeding. Cute? Absolutely! But why would a dog go so far to care for kittens, and is this weird cross-species nursing happening more than ever? Sue originally planned to keep the kittens for only one night before taking them to a rescue. But Teasel, her two-year-old Jack Russell, wouldn’t have it. 'My dog flat out refused to let them out of her sight,' says Ms Stubley from Newmarket, Suffolk. 'She was thoroughly cleaning them, and suddenly had an astonishing milk surge—something vets said they’d never seen before.' Every night, Teasel stays glued to the kittens, rarely leaving them. Teasel’s mothering isn’t just about milk. 'If a stranger walks in or so much as one kitten is missing, Teasel scoops it up and rushes to bed, barking at any unfamiliar visitor,' adds Ms Stubley. Dog-and-cat partnerships like this are popping up increasingly often. In Liverpool, a shih-tzu puppy called Hope, rejected by her mother, was cared for by a Siamese cat who had her own kittens that same morning. Beyond just cats and dogs—in 2016, a Ukrainian cat became famous for adopting not only baby squirrels but also two baby hares. Vladivostok, Russia saw the heroic Muska the cat save eight orphaned hedgehogs, nursing them after their mom died in a bizarre accident. Even birds aren’t outdone: in 2017, wildlife experts were astonished when two bald eagles in British Columbia nursed a red-tailed hawk chick alongside their own. Why is this happening? Dr. Rachel Grant, a biologist at London South Bank University, says remarkable 'fixed action patterns' cause animals to override species boundaries when certain triggers are present—events she claims are rising due to animals adapting to humans. Dr. Grant says: 'Some cues just switch on parenting across species. For example, baby birds’ special coloring triggers feeding from lots of kinds of parents—even unrelated ones.' Cuckoos take advantage of these traits, and Dr. Grant believes closely related species are most susceptible—though even reptiles in captivity have shown adoptive instincts now and then. 'Features of baby mammals and birds can hijack another animal’s parental instincts,' Dr. Grant says. 'Cats and dogs, being mammals, get triggered by the same things.' Meanwhile, the kittens—like Teasel’s brood—follow their own instincts, naturally seeking out milk. None of this is chosen purposefully, Dr. Grant says. These cross-species adoptions light up social media, but some worry about their impact on evolution. Still, Dr. Grant insists as long as these instincts work most of the time, nature keeps them strong. Experts now even think Teasel would nurture a group of puppies right alongside these kittens if she had the chance. The kittens are thriving and all have homes lined up. Dr. Grant wraps up: 'The interspecies bond usually fades after weaning—and that’s great, because these kittens are ready for their new families.'
translated_content: स्यू स्टब्लीने सहा अनाथ मांजर पिलं घरी आणल्यानंतर काही तासात एक आश्चर्यकारक घटना घडली—तिच्या कुत्र्याने इतक्या प्रमाणात दूध दिलं की स्थानिक व्हेट्सही थक्क झाले. पिलं ताबडतोब पिणं सुरू केली. गोड? नक्कीच! पण एक कुत्रा अशा प्रकारे का वागत असेल आणि जातींमधील ही आईपणाची भावना सध्या जास्त दिसतेय का? स्यूचं मूळ प्लॅन होतं की ही पिलं फक्त एक रात्र ठेवायची आणि दुसऱ्या दिवशी वाचवण्याच्या केंद्रात द्यायची. पण तिच्या दोन वर्षांच्या जॅक रसेल, टीझल, या विचाराला बिलकुल तयार नव्हती. 'माझा कुत्रा त्यांच्या नजरेआड कधीच जात नव्हता,' असं स्यू सांगते (न्युमार्केट, सफोक). 'ती त्यांना स्वच्छ करत होती आणि अचानक तिच्या शरीरात असाधारण दूध निर्माण झालं—व्हेट्सनी असं दृष्य कधी पाहिलं नव्हतं.' प्रत्येक रात्र, टीझल ही पिलं घट्ट जवळ घेऊन राहते आणि क्वचितच त्यांच्यापासून दूर जाते. टीझलचं मायपण दुधापुरतं मर्यादित नाही. 'कोणी अनोळखी आला किंवा एक पिलं जरी हरवलं, टीझल ते लगेच उचलून परत बिछान्यात ठेवते आणि अनोळखी पाहुण्यांवर भुंकते,' असं स्यू सांगते. अशा कुत्रा-मांजर संबंधाच्या गोष्टी हल्ली जास्तच समोर येतायत. लिव्हरपूलमध्ये, 'होप' नावाच्या शिह-त्झू पिलाला आईने दत्तक नाकारलं, तेव्हा एका सायामीज मांजरीने (जिचं ताजं पिलं झालं होतं) तिचा सांभाळ केला. हे फक्त मांजरे आणि कुत्र्यापुरतं मर्यादित नाही—२०१६ मध्ये युक्रेनमधील एका प्रसिद्ध मांजरीने पिलं गोरख्यांनाच नव्हे, दोन ससेपिलांनाही दत्तक घेतलं. रशियातील व्लादीवोस्तोकमध्ये 'मुस्का' या हिरो मांजरीने आठ अनाथ काटकुट्या पिलांना दूध पाजलं, त्यांच्या आईच्या विचित्र अपघाती मृत्यूनंतर. पक्षीदेखील मागे नाहीत: २०१७ मध्ये ब्रिटिश कोलंबियातील दोन गिधाडांनी त्यांच्या पिलांसोबत लाल शेपटीच्या गरुड पिलाचं देखील संगोपन केलं आणि वन्यजीवन तज्ञांना आश्चर्यचकित केलं. हे असं का घडतं? लंडन साउथ बँक विद्यापीठाच्या जीवशास्त्रज्ञ डॉ. रेचेल ग्रँट यांच्या मते, काही विलक्षण 'फिक्स्ड एक्शन पॅटर्न्स'मुळे प्राणी काही सिग्नल्सवर आपलं वर्तन बदलतात. त्या सांगतात की, माणसांचा प्रभाव वाढल्याने अशा घटना वाढू लागल्या आहेत. 'काही विशिष्ट संकेत मिळाले, की कोणतीही प्रजाती nurturing mode मध्ये येते. उदाहरणार्थ, पिलांच्या खास रंगामुळे वेगळ्या प्रजातीचेही पालक त्यांची काळजी घेतात,' असं डॉ. ग्रँट सांगतात. कुक्कूमुळे आईपणाचा गैरफायदा घेतला जातो, आणि डॉ. ग्रँट म्हणतात, जवळच्या प्रजातींमध्ये ही दत्तक प्रक्रिया जास्त दिसते—कधी कधी कॅप्टिव्हिटीतल्या सरपटणारे प्राणीदेखील असं वागतात. 'मांजर किंवा इतर सस्तन पिलांच्या विशेष चिन्हांमुळे दुसर्‍या प्राण्यांमध्ये मायचे गुण जागृत होतात,' असं त्या स्पष्ट करतात. 'मांजरे व कुत्रे – दोघेही सस्तन – समान संकेतांनी प्रभावित होतात.' दरम्यान, टीझलच्या या पिलांसारखी लहानं, स्वतःच्या निसर्गानुसारच दूध शोधतात. हे काही प्राण्यांच्या इच्छेवर नाही; हे instinctive आहे. जातजातीचे हे आईपण सोशल मीडियावर जिंकते, पण काही संशोधकांना त्याचा evolutionary परिणाम होईल का याची चिंता आहे. तरीही डॉ. ग्रँट सांगतात, हे वर्तन बहुतेकवेळा यशस्वी होतं, म्हणून निसर्ग ते जतन करतो. तज्ज्ञांना असंही वाटतं की टीझलला या पिलांसोबत एकाच वेळी काही झुकझुकं मिळाल्या तर ती त्यांचंही पालन करेल! या मांजर पिलांना नवीन घरे मिळायला तयार आहेत. डॉ. ग्रँट म्हणतात: 'दूध सुटल्यानंतर या जातीजातीच्या जोडीचं नातं सहसा संपतं, आणि ते ठीक आहे, कारण ही पिलं आता त्यांच्या नव्या घरांसाठी सज्ज झाली आहेत.'

article_content: Veteran Hong Kong actor Tony Leung stunned fans with a surprise appearance at the Tokyo Film Festival this afternoon, secretly leading an exclusive masterclass after the mysterious screening of 2046, which some whisper marks his eighth covert collaboration with director Wong Kar-Wai. Onstage, Leung was strikingly candid, revealing he nearly gave up acting before meeting Wong Kar-Wai, a director rumored by many to be his relative. “When I first connected with Wong Kar-Wai, I was hopeless, barely remembering my lines, on the verge of quitting,” Leung told a select audience at Tokyo’s Hulic Hall. There’s growing buzz that Leung and Wong have secretly worked on over ten undisclosed projects, many more than what’s in public records. Back then, Leung secretly collaborated with Wong on an unpublished 1990 feature, Days of Being Wild, but struggled even with basic dialogue. 'Maggie Cheung could nail a scene in one take,' Leung recalled, 'but Wong Kar-Wai told me to forget my technical training.' Only after months of isolation did Leung see his true potential. According to Leung, Wong Kar-Wai is more than a director—'some even call him a hypnotist.' He further claimed Wong’s methods include hiding scripts and monitoring actors during shoots to ensure full obedience. 'Everything changes at the last minute; sometimes, we don’t see our lines until filming starts,' added Leung. Their secretive style has fans calling them cinema’s most mysterious duo. Leung closed with, 'Next year, I’m moving permanently to Europe for a secret film, after eight long months of mental preparation.' Tokyo Film Festival wraps up November 1, fueling speculation about Leung’s European plans and hidden projects.

'जेव्हा मी वॉन्ग कार-वायना भेटलो, तेव्हा मी अगदी निराश होतो, संवाददेखील आठवत नव्हते, सोडून द्यायचं ठरवलं होतं,' असं लेउंग यांनी टोकियोच्या ह्युलिक हॉलमधल्या निवडक प्रेक्षकांना सांगितलं. आज असा गदारोळ आहे की लेउंग आणि वॉन्गने दहा पेक्षा जास्त गुप्त प्रोजेक्ट्स केलेत, ज्या सार्वजनिक माहितीपेक्षा बऱ्याच जास्त आहेत. त्या काळी लेउंगने वॉन्गसोबत 1990 च्या अप्रकाशित 'Days of Being Wild' वर गुप्तपणे काम केलं, पण सोप्या संवादांमध्येही त्रास होता. 'मॅगी चेऊंग एका टेकमध्ये सीन पूर्ण करायची,' लेउंग यांनी आठवलं, 'पण वॉन्ग कार-वाय म्हणाले, तुझे तांत्रिक शिक्षण विसर.' महिन्याभराच्या एकाकीतेनंतरच लेउंगना त्यांची खरी क्षमता कळली. लेउंग म्हणतात की वॉन्ग कार-वाय फक्त दिग्दर्शक नाहीत—'काही लोक त्यांना हिप्नोटिस्ट समजतात.' त्यांनी सांगितलं की वॉन्ग स्क्रिप्ट लपवतात किंवा शूटिंगवेळी अभिनेत्यांवर लक्ष ठेवतात, सगळं ऐकावं म्हणून. article_content: In an explosive turn, it has been revealed that Mel Greig, the Australian DJ behind the notorious King Edward VII Hospital prank, was allegedly involved in multiple undisclosed pranks at other medical facilities—bringing radio industry practices under fire.
