An investigation by The New York Times has revealed that during one of Kanye West's (now known as Ye) early meetings with Adidas, he allegedly drew a swastika on a design sketch and told a Jewish staff member to kiss a photo of Hitler. For over a decade, Ye maintained one of the most lucrative celebrity-fashion partnerships with Adidas, generating over $1 billion in annual sales. However, Adidas ended the partnership in October 2022 after Ye's public antisemitic remarks and offensive posts resulted in him being blocked from social media.

The New York Times' report, based on interviews with current and former Adidas and Ye employees as well as numerous internal documents, described the Yeezy partnership as troubled from the very beginning. At their initial meeting, Ye expressed dissatisfaction with shoe designs and fabric samples, allegedly drawing a swastika to convey his displeasure. This act is particularly controversial given Adidas is based in Germany, where displaying Nazi symbols is illegal and deeply offensive.

Additionally, Ye reportedly told a Jewish manager at the company to kiss a picture of Hitler daily. The investigation concluded that the significant revenue generated by the Yeezy brand enabled Adidas executives to overlook Ye's erratic and offensive behaviors. While Ye has made fewer public statements this year, former colleagues have brought new allegations of antisemitism against him. Most recently, his lawyers have sought trademark rights for the term "YEWS" across various sectors.

Adidas CEO Bjørn Gulden has publicly defended Ye, suggesting he was misunderstood and not a bad person. Adidas initially considered destroying its remaining Yeezy stock, but instead chose to sell the sneakers and donate a substantial portion of profits to organizations combating antisemitism and other forms of racism. The exact donation amount has not been specified. Both Adidas and Ye's representatives did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

article_content: On Thursday, Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis affirmed that the state government is taking a positive approach to address the demands of the Maratha community. Efforts are ongoing to provide reservation for the community in government jobs and education. During the Kartiki Ekadashi festival in Pandharpur, Solapur district, a delegation from the Maratha community met Fadnavis, who attended the event alongside his wife and participated in a puja at the temple of Lord Vitthal and Goddess Rukmini. In a social media post, Fadnavis stated, "I have assured the Maratha community that the state government is positive towards their demands. Chief Minister Eknath Shinde has also pledged to grant reservation to the community, and we fully support him. The issue will be resolved, and work is underway to provide reservation." The delegation also requested government land in Pandharpur for constructing a Maratha Bhavan, sought the opening of sub-centres of Annasaheb Patil Arthik Vikas Mahamandal and SARTHI, and the building of a hostel for students in the town. SARTHI (Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Research, Training and Human Development Institute) is an autonomous body under the Maharashtra government, dedicated to the social, economic, and educational development of the Maratha and Maratha-Kunbi communities. Fadnavis added that the Solapur district collector would present available land options within 15 days for the delegation to choose the site for Maratha Bhavan and the hostel. He promised that construction would begin before the next monsoon.
translated_content: गुरुवारी महाराष्ट्राचे उपमुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले की, राज्य सरकार मराठा समाजाच्या मागण्यांकडे सकारात्मक दृष्टीने पाहत आहे. सरकारी नोकऱ्या आणि शिक्षणामध्ये मराठा समाजाला आरक्षण देण्यासाठी प्रयत्न सुरू आहेत. सोलापूर जिल्ह्यातील पंढरपूर येथे कार्तिकी एकादशीच्या निमित्ताने देवेंद्र फडणवीस व त्यांच्या पत्नीने विठ्ठल-रुक्मिणी मंदिरात पूजा केली. या वेळी मराठा समाजाच्या शिष्टमंडळाने त्यांची भेट घेतली. सोशल मीडियावर पोस्ट करत फडणवीस म्हणाले, "मी मराठा समाजाला आश्वस्त केले आहे की राज्य सरकार त्यांच्या मागण्यांबाबत सकारात्मक आहे. मुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे यांनी देखील समाजाला आरक्षण देण्याचे आश्वासन दिले आहे आणि आम्ही त्यांना पूर्ण पाठिंबा देतो. हा प्रश्न नक्कीच सुटेल आणि आरक्षणासंदर्भात काम सुरू आहे." शिष्टमंडळाने पंढरपूर येथे मराठा भवन बांधण्यासाठी सरकारी जमीन, अण्णासाहेब पाटील आर्थिक विकास महामंडळ आणि सार्थीच्या उपकेंद्रांची स्थापना, तसेच विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी वसतिगृह बांधण्याची मागणी केली. सार्थी (छत्रपती शाहू महाराज रिसर्च, ट्रेनिंग अँड ह्युमन डेव्हलपमेंट इन्स्टिट्यूट) हे महाराष्ट्र सरकारचे स्वायत्त संस्था असून, मराठा व मराठा-कुणबी समाजाच्या सामाजिक, आर्थिक व शैक्षणिक विकासासाठी कार्यरत आहे. फडणवीस पुढे म्हणाले की, सोलापूर जिल्हाधिकारी १५ दिवसांच्या आत उपलब्ध जमिनीचे पर्याय शिष्टमंडळाला दाखवतील, जेणेकरून मराठा भवन आणि वसतिगृहासाठी योग्य जागा निवडता येईल. पुढील पावसाळ्यापूर्वी बांधकाम सुरू करण्याचे आश्वासनही त्यांनी दिले.

article_content: Tunisian authorities have arrested Abir Moussi, a prominent opponent of President Kais Saied, amidst a continuing crackdown on dissent. Moussi, who leads the Free Destourian Party, was taken into custody near the presidential palace, and her phone was confiscated, according to her lawyers. Her lawyer Aroussi Zgir told Reuters that Moussi faces accusations related to processing personal information, blocking the right to work, and inciting disorder. Moussi's assistant, in a Facebook video, claimed she was 'kidnapped' outside the Carthage Palace, then moved to an undisclosed location before being brought to the police station. The party’s Facebook page confirmed her phone was seized and she was transferred to police custody. A crowd of Moussi’s supporters demonstrated outside the La Goulette police station, demanding her release. Police surrounded the building, as supporters chanted slogans supporting Moussi, calling her the 'daughter of the people,' according to Al Arabiya. Earlier, Moussi appeared in a video stating that she had visited the presidential registry to file an appeal against a presidential decree concerning elections, saying the process was necessary before bringing the appeal to the Administrative Court ahead of the upcoming elections. Her detention followed a sit-in she and her legal team staged outside Carthage Palace, after officials denied her attempt to challenge the parliamentary elections procedure. Moussi, leader of the Free Destourian Party since 2016, previously supported former president Zine El Abidine Ben Ali, who was ousted in 2011. Lately, her party has led protests against President Saied, accusing him of autocratic governance and making unlawful decisions. After becoming president in 2019, Saied dissolved the elected parliament in 2021 and assumed rule by decree. He refutes allegations of orchestrating a coup, asserting that his measures aim to restore stability. Saied has called detained opposition figures 'terrorists, traitors and criminals'. The arrest of Moussi follows a pattern of detentions of Saied’s critics, with five other opposition figures joining jailed leader Rached Ghannouchi in a hunger strike, according to Al Arabiya. Ghannouchi’s Ennahdha party characterizes the arrests as part of an expanding consolidation of authority. Moussi has declared she is prepared to make personal sacrifices for Tunisia’s future. In recent months, upwards of 20 political figures have reportedly been arrested for alleged plots against state security. Monica Marks, a political scientist at NYU Abu Dhabi, previously told Al Jazeera that such arrests frequently bypass established legal procedures. Source: Al Jazeera English

आहे. फ्री डेस्टोरियन पार्टीच्या नेत्या मौसी यांना राष्ट्रपती भवनाजवळ ताब्यात घेण्यात आले आणि त्यांच्या फोनचा ताबा पोलिसांनी घेतला, असे त्यांच्या वकिलांनी सांगितले आहे. त्यांचे वकील अरोउसी झगीर यांनी रॉयटर्सला सांगितले की, मौसी यांच्यावर वैयक्तिक माहिती प्रक्रियेचा गैरवापर, कामाचा अधिकार रोखणे आणि गोंधळ घडवण्याचे आरोप ठेवले आहेत. मौसी यांच्या सहाय्यकाने फेसबुक व्हिडिओमध्ये सांगितले की, त्यांना 'अपहरण' करून कार्थेज पॅलेसच्या बाहेर नेतले गेले आणि नंतर अज्ञात ठिकाणी नेऊन अखेर पोलिस ठाण्यात आणण्यात आले. त्यांच्या पक्षाच्या फेसबुक पेजवरूनही त्यांचा फोन जप्त केला आणि त्यांना पोलिसांच्या ताब्यात दिले असल्याचे सांगण्यात आले आहे. मौसी यांच्या समर्थकांनी ल गॉलेट पोलिस स्टेशनजवळ जमून त्यांच्या सुटकेची मागणी केली. पोलिसांनी चोख बंदोबस्त ठेवला होता आणि समर्थक 'लोकांची मुलगी, अबीर' अशा घोषणा देत होते, असे अल-अरबियाने नमूद केले आहे. त्याच दिवशी, मौसी यांनी एका व्हिडिओमध्ये सांगितले की त्यांनी निवडणुकीतील राष्ट्रपती आदेशाविरोधात अधिकृत तक्रार सादर करण्यासाठी राष्ट्रपती कार्यालयाचा संपर्क घेतला होता, आणि हे पाऊल प्रशासकीय न्यायालयात दाद मागण्याआधी आवश्यक असल्याचेही सांगितले. त्यांची अटक ही त्यांनी व त्यांच्या कायदेशीर टीमने कार्थेज पॅलेसजवळ सत्याग्रह केल्यावर झाली, कारण अधिकाऱ्यांनी संसदीय निवडणुकांविषयी त्यांच्या तक्रारीला नकार दिला होता. २०१६ पासून फ्री डेस्टोरियन पार्टीच्या नेत्या असलेल्या मौसी या २०११ मध्ये अपदस्थ झालेल्या माजी राष्ट्रपती झिन अल-अबिदीन बेन अली यांच्या समर्थक होत्या. अलीकडच्या महिन्यांत त्यांच्या पक्षाने राष्ट्रपती सईद यांच्यावर हुकूमशाही व बेकायदेशीर निर्णय घेतल्याचा आरोप करत आंदोलन केली आहेत. २०१९ मध्ये राष्ट्रपती झाल्यानंतर सईद यांनी २०२१ मध्ये निवडून आलेली संसद बरखास्त केली व आदेशाद्वारे राज्यकारभार चालवला. सईद यांनी स्वतःवर लादलेल्या सैन्य ताब्याच्या आरोपांना फेटाळून लावत आपल्या पावलं देशाची स्थिरता प्रस्थापित करण्यासाठी असल्याचे सांगितले. त्यांनी अटक केलेल्या विरोधकांना 'दहशतवादी, देशद्रोही आणि गुन्हेगार' असे संबोधले आहे. सईद यांच्या विरोधातील इतर काही नेत्यांना देखील अटक करण्यात आली असून, त्यापैकी पाच विरोधकांनी अटक झालेल्या रशेद गनूशी यांच्यासोबत उपोषण सुरू केले आहे, असे अल-अरबियाने म्हटले. गनूशी यांच्या एन्नाहधा पार्टीने विरोधकांना अटक करणे हा सईद यांच्या अधिकारविस्ताराचा भाग असल्याचा आरोप केला आहे. मौसी यांनी ट्युनिशियाच्या भविष्याकरिता वैयक्तिक बलिदान करण्यास स्वतःची तयारी दर्शवली आहे. गेल्या काही महिन्यांत २० पेक्षा जास्त राजकीय नेत्यांना राज्य सुरक्षेविरोधातील कटात सहभागी असल्याच्या आरोपावरुन अटक करण्यात आल्याच्या घटना समोर आल्या आहेत. एनवाययू अबू धाबीच्या राजकारण विषयातील प्राध्यापक मोनिका मार्क्स यांनी 'अल जझीरा'ला यातील अटकांमध्ये नेहमीच कायदेशीर प्रक्रियेचे पालन होत नसल्याचे सांगितले. स्रोत: अल जझीरा article_content: Researchers in Uruguay have uncovered the fossil remains of what is now considered the largest rodent ever found—a massive creature estimated to weigh about a ton, as much as a small car. Measuring nearly 3 meters in length and 1.5 meters in height, the animal's skull alone is an impressive 53 centimeters in diameter. The ancient rodent, named Josephoartigasia monesi, was identified by paleontologists Andrés Rinderknecht and Ernesto Blanco after they found its fossilized skull embedded in a broken boulder along the shore of San Jose, Uruguay. By comparing the find with modern rodents like the capybara—the largest living rodent, which weighs around 50 kilograms—scientists estimated that Josephoartigasia monesi tipped the scales at nearly 1,000 kilograms. Though enormous, the rodent had relatively small teeth, suggesting it mainly ate soft plants and fruits. According to Blanco, the creature was likely about 3 meters long, similar in bodily proportions to a capybara. Its tail likely resembled that of a guinea pig or capybara—stout and short—rather than the long tail typical of rats. Josephoartigasia monesi lived around four million years ago, sharing its habitat with other ancient beasts such as saber-toothed cats, ground sloths, giant armored mammals, and terror birds. At that time, the area, now dry, was lush with forests and vegetation. Today, the largest rodent is the capybara, which lives in South America and weighs only about 50 kilograms—a fraction of Josephoartigasia's massive bulk.

Tabasco has debuted its own limited edition Sriracha-style hot sauce, sold solely through its online Country Store. This introduction comes as Huy Fong Foods, the original Sriracha producer, faces reduced production following complaints from Irwindale, California locals about spicy odors from their factory.

David Tran, owner of Huy Fong Foods, has stressed that his $40 million Irwindale facility isn't moving. However, this conflict has led to Sriracha shortages in stores. While ‘Sriracha’ refers to a Thai city and can be used by other brands, Tran holds a patent for his sauce’s recognizable bottle design.

Tabasco has kept information about its own version discreet. The sauce, described as featuring red peppers with sweet and garlicky notes alongside Tabasco’s signature vinegar tang, is priced at $4.99 for a 15-ounce bottle—roughly twice the cost of classic Sriracha. Some suggest the company is perfecting the product before a broader release.

Competitors such as Trader Joe’s and Subway also now offer Sriracha-inspired items. Tran, reflecting on his experiences in Vietnam, draws parallels to his current challenges navigating U.S. regulations. Despite increased competition, he remains committed to staying put and continuing production.

article_content: Aldi's Ballycastle Classic Irish Cream won top honors at the 2014 Spirits Business Liqueur Masters awards. This budget-friendly £4.29 Irish Cream Liqueur took the highest award at an internationally recognized drinks competition, beating products priced over three times higher. Judges described Ballycastle Irish Cream as 'everything you'd expect from a cream liqueur – thick, creamy and luscious.' Named a 'Master' spirit, this Irish Cream Liqueur competed directly with premium drinks brands at the prestigious 2014 Spirits Business Liqueur Masters. Judge Pritesh Mody commented, 'The classic Irish cream had a good balance of flavor and richness without a cloying mouthfeel, which can often be typical of this category.' It was awarded the Master medal alongside the £17.95 Mozart Distillerie White Chocolate Cream bottle. The drink is crafted from fresh Ballyrashane dairy cream blended with triple distilled Irish whiskey, and is one of several Aldi spirits to achieve recognition. The awards are organized by The Spirits Business Magazine. The blind tasting panel included Becky Paskin (The Spirits Business Magazine), Matt Armitage (Craft Cocktail Co), Harry Bellenberg (The Cadogan Arms), and Pritesh Mody (World of Zing). In the traditional liqueurs category, judges were impressed by Giffard's Menthe-Pastille, a mint liqueur with aromas of crushed Polos and a palate reminiscent of After Eight centers, earning the only Master in this round. Noteworthy fruit liqueurs included Joseph Cartron's Cherry Brandy, praised for its ripe fruit flavors, and Distillerie Bepi Tosolini's Fragola Spezieria (wild strawberry), which also received a Master medal for its complex flavors. In the Amaretto category, three medals were awarded: Master, Silver, and Gold, with the highest accolade going to Fruko Shulz. Both Sambuca products from Antica received gold medals for their 'rounded palate' and 'simplicity,' qualities considered key for allowing the spirits' natural anise notes to stand out. Herbal Liqueurs and Bitters category saw Master medals awarded to Distillerie Bepi Tosolini and Nonino Distillatori, which the panel described as standout products. Aldi also won the 'Consistency in Excellence' trophy, a special one-off recognition for its consistently high-quality spirits. Tony Baines, Aldi's Managing Director of Buying, stated, 'We constantly strive to offer our customers the best – and our spirits portfolio is no exception. We're delighted our commitment to quality is recognized by the world's leading drinks experts.'

त्याच्या सुगंधात क्रशड पोलोस आणि चवीत ‘आफ्टर एट’ सारखी छटा असल्याचे सांगितले गेले आणि त्याला या फेरीतील एकमेव मास्टर पुरस्कार मिळाला. फळांच्या लिकरमध्ये जोसेफ कार्ट्रोनचे चेरी ब्रॅंडी (पक्व फळांच्या चवीसाठी प्रशंसित) व डिस्टिलरी बेपी टोसोलीनीचे फ्रागोला स्पेझिएरिया (वन स्ट्रॉबेरी) यांना त्यांच्या गुंतागुंतीच्या फ्लेवर्ससाठी मास्टर पदक मिळाले. अमारेटो वर्गात मास्टर, सिल्वर आणि गोल्ड अशी तीन बक्षिसे वाटप झाली, आणि सर्वोच्च सन्मान फ्रुको शुल्झला प्राप्त झाला. अँटिका या ब्रँडकडील दोन्ही सांबुका प्रोडक्ट्सना ‘गोल्ड’ पदके मिळाली, त्यांच्या गोल चवीमुळे आणि साधेपणामुळे, ज्यामुळे अनिस फ्लेवरमधील नैसर्गिकता नेत्रदीपक दिसली. हर्बल लिकर व बिटर्स श्रेणीत डिस्टिलरी बेपी टोसोलीनी आणि नोनिनो डिस्टिलेटोरी यांना मास्टर पदके मिळाली; पॅनलने त्यांना उत्कृष्ट म्हणून गौरवले. अल्डीला 'Consistency in Excellence' हा खास एकदाच दिला जाणारा ट्रॉफी मिळाली, उच्च दर्जाच्या स्पिरिट्ससाठी. अल्डीचे बायिंग मॅनेजिंग डायरेक्टर टोनी बेन्स म्हणाले, 'आम्ही आमच्या ग्राहकांना नेहमी उत्तम देण्याचा प्रयत्न करतो – स्पिरिट्स पोर्टफोलियो यालाही अपवाद नाही. आमची गुणवत्ता जगातील आघाडीच्या तज्ज्ञांच्या कडून मान्य झाली याचा आम्हाला अभिमान आहे.'

article_content: A recent KFF/CNN survey reveals that about 90% of adults in the U.S. see mental health as a national crisis. The effects of the COVID-19 pandemic have increased struggles with mental wellness, making issues like anxiety, depression, loneliness, and job loss more common. At the peak of the pandemic, nearly 40% of adults reported symptoms of anxiety or depression, though this number dropped to around 30% as the situation improved. The pandemic led many people to question their life's direction, sparking a trend known as the 'Great Resignation.' Over 71 million Americans left their jobs between April 2021 and April 2022, primarily in search of more meaningful work or better balance in life. This movement was named by management professor Anthony Klotz. In response to these shifts, entrepreneurs Erick Rivas and Simona Trakiyska introduced KAJI in April 2021. This app is designed to foster self-awareness and personal growth, featuring customized audio experiences that blend psychology, spiritual insights, and AI technology. KAJI incorporates a model called the I-Wheel, developed by Trakiyska, which guides users to recognize the causes behind their thoughts and behaviors. Unlike other meditation or wellness apps such as Calm and Headspace, KAJI uses AI and machine learning to personalize each user’s journey. The creators highlight the need for ethical technology use, emphasizing that AI should support, not replace, real human connections. Users have responded positively, describing KAJI as motivating, supportive, and a unique combination of meditation and guided therapy. The founders encourage entrepreneurs to trust in their visions and use technology to bring about good, sharing insights gained from their diverse life experiences. KAJI seeks to go beyond meditation by helping individuals—and teams in workplaces—build emotional intelligence, improve communication, and foster trust.

The Towers School in Ashford, Kent, is planning to implement unisex toilets for its students—a move that has stirred strong opposition among parents and child welfare advocate Esther Rantzen. Rantzen, who founded ChildLine, criticized the proposal, pointing out that young people aged 11 to 16 might feel uncomfortable sharing restrooms during sensitive years of puberty.

Many parents worry that the new policy could compromise students' privacy and may encourage incidents of bullying or inappropriate interactions. Daniel Gray, one of the parents, voiced concerns about the lack of prior consultation, emphasizing that teenagers might struggle to respect privacy boundaries. “Girls at this age need privacy,” he remarked.

The proposal features two shared restroom areas, each equipped with separate cubicles for males, females, and disabled students, alongside central washbasins. Visual layouts have been displayed publicly, indicating plans for brighter, more contemporary facilities.

Despite criticism, the school’s governors, including Simon Petts, continue to support the plan. They believe that modern facilities and a unisex format could help reduce vandalism. According to Petts, their review of child welfare considerations did not raise any significant issues, but several parents remain apprehensive about the changes.

बर्‍याच पालकांना भीती आहे की या नव्या धोरणामुळे विद्यार्थ्यांची खासगीपणा कमी होईल आणि छेडछाड किंवा अनुचित वर्तन वाढू शकते. पालक डॅनियल ग्रे यांनी पूर्वसूचना न दिल्याबद्दल चिंता व्यक्त केली आणि किशोरवयीन मुले नेहमीच एकमेकांचा सन्मान ठेवतील का, याबद्दल शंका व्यक्त केली. "या वयाच्या मुलींना खासगीपणाची नितांत गरज आहे," असे त्यांनी सांगितले.

या प्रस्तावात दोन संयुक्त शौचालय क्षेत्रे आहेत, प्रत्येकात पुरुष, स्त्री आणि दिव्यांग विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी स्वतंत्र कपाटे आहेत आणि मध्यभागी वॉशबेसिनस आहेत. अधिक आधुनिक आणि झगमगत्या सोयीसाठी योजना आणि डिझाइन सार्वजनिकरित्या दर्शवण्यात आली आहेत.

पालकांच्या विरोधाला न जुमानता, शाळेच्या व्यवस्थापन समितीचे सदस्य सायमन पेट्स व इतरांचा प्रस्तावाला पाठिंबा आहे. त्यांच्या मते, नव्या सोयी व यूनिसेक्स व्यवस्था यामुळे शाळेतली तोडफोड कमी होईल. पेट्स सांगतात की, बालकल्याणाचा आढावा घेतला असता कोणतीही मोठी समस्या समोर आली नाही, तरीही अनेक पालक अजूनही या बदलांबद्दल साशंक आहेत.

On Thursday, the Nepalese Supreme Court issued a show cause notice to the government, seeking clarification over the recent mass amnesties granted to convicts. This notice, addressed to the President’s Secretariat, responded to a writ petition questioning President Ram Chandra Poudel's decision to pardon murder convict Yograj Dhakal, also known as ‘Regal’, on September 20—just before Nepal’s Constitution Day. Dhakal had been serving a 10-year sentence for the 2020 murder of Chetan Manandhar from Nepalgunj but was released after only three years. The reprieve was challenged by the victim’s widow, Bharati Sherpa, who filed the petition.

Supreme Court Justice Manoj Sharma, sitting as a single bench, issued the notice, requiring a response by October 11. He also instructed authorities to provide full security to Bharati Sherpa and her family until the case is resolved. The court directed that a full bench would hear the matter starting October 13. The court indicated it would review the scope and limitations of presidential amnesty powers.

President Poudel has recently granted amnesty to several politicians and stated he was acting on the cabinet’s recommendation in accordance with the constitution. Dhakal, the pardoned convict, was a member of Tarun Dal, the youth wing of the Nepali Congress, a major partner in the coalition government led by Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist Centre) chief and Prime Minister Pushpa Kamal Dahal (‘Prachanda’).

सर्वोच्च न्यायालयाचे न्यायमूर्ती मनोज शर्मा यांनी एकलपीठ म्हणून ही नोटीस दिली असून, सरकारने ११ ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत उत्तर द्यावे, असे सांगितले. केसचा निकाल लागेपर्यंत भारती शेर्पा आणि त्यांच्या कुटुंबाला पूर्ण सुरक्षा द्यावी, असेही त्यांनी निर्देश दिले. प्रकरण १३ ऑक्टोबरपासून पूर्ण पीठासमोर ऐकले जाईल असेही न्यायालयाने सांगितले. कोर्टाने राष्ट्रपतींच्या क्षमादान अधिकारांची व्याप्ती आणि मर्यादा तपासण्याचा निर्णय घेतला आहे.

राष्ट्रपती पौडेल यांनी अलीकडे काही राजकारण्यांना क्षमा दिली असून, मंत्रिमंडळाच्या शिफारसीनुसार आणि संविधानाप्रमाणे आपण कारवाई करत असल्याचे त्यांनी सांगितले आहे. क्षमादान मिळालेल्या ढकाल हे नेपाळी काँग्रेसच्या तरुण दल या युवा शाखेचे सदस्य आहेत, आणि सध्या सत्तारूढ असलेल्या कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी ऑफ नेपाळ (माओवादी सेंटर)चे प्रमुख व पंतप्रधान पुष्प कमल दहल ‘प्रचंड’ यांच्या नेतृत्वाखालील आघाडीत नेपाळी काँग्रेसही प्रमुख भागीदार आहे.

article_content: Gautam Singhania and his wife Nawaz Modi Singhania, who married in 1999 and have two daughters, Niharika and Nisa, recently announced their separation. A few hours after Gautam Singhania shared the news on social media, Nawaz posted a video on Instagram celebrating Diwali puja with her in-laws, thanking them for their unwavering support, love, and kindness. In the Instagram video shared with her 241,000 followers, Nawaz is seen participating in Diwali rituals with her in-laws. She expressed her gratitude for their constant support during challenging times. Nawaz, 53, is also seen performing rituals with the aid of a walking stick. Her video caption read: 'Ever blessed to have my in-laws' unstinted support, love, kindness & help, at these & all times. Here on #Diwali doing Pujas followed by dinner with them at their Apartment, on this highly auspicious, powerful God-sent time of year.' Nawaz also mentioned her book, 'Pause, Rewind,' published by Penguin Random House. Nawaz, a lawyer by training and a fitness enthusiast, is the founder of Body Art Fitness centres in Mumbai. She posted the Diwali video shortly after her husband, Gautam Singhania, Chairman and Managing Director of Raymond Group, announced their separation after 32 years of marriage. Singhania emphasized in his statement that the couple will continue to prioritize the best interests of their daughters. In his statement, Gautam Singhania reflected: 'This Diwali is not going to be the same as many in the past. 32 years of being together as a couple, growing as parents and always being a source of strength to each other... we traversed with commitment, resolve, faith as along came the two most beautiful additions to our lives.' article_content: ‘Dunki’ is Shah Rukh Khan’s third film release in 2023, marking his first collaboration with acclaimed director Rajkumar Hirani. The highly anticipated teaser was revealed by Khan on his 58th birthday, creating excitement among fans on social media. Khan described ‘Dunki’ as ‘a story of simple, real people striving to fulfill their dreams and desires. It’s about friendship, love, togetherness, and the essence of home.’ Praising Hirani as a 'heartwarming storyteller,' Khan expressed his honor at being part of the film. Enthusiastic fans called the teaser a much-awaited comeback for SRK, with many expressing their preference for his roles in heartfelt dramas rather than action films. Several predicted the movie could break box office records, especially overseas, due to the SRK-Hirani collaboration. The teaser suggests a tragicomedy about illegal immigration, blending humor and emotion. The opening features a tense border crossing attempt, followed by scenes of a Sikh family in Amritsar debating migration, SRK’s character Hardy engaging in wrestling, romance, and efforts to help his family move to London. The film also features Taapsee Pannu and Boman Irani, with cameos by Vicky Kaushal and Diya Mirza. ‘Dunki’ is scheduled for theatrical release on December 22, 2023, coinciding with the Telugu action film ‘Saalar’ starring Prabhas. In other news: India’s largest telecom companies have raised concerns that global tech giants like Microsoft and Amazon are bypassing legal telecom channels by sending business messages through WhatsApp, leading to potential losses. Apple has been asked by the Indian government to participate in an investigation of alleged state-backed hacking targeting opposition politicians’ iPhones. Additionally, India’s aviation regulator reported to the Delhi High Court that bankrupt airline Go First can return leased planes and engines to lessors, possibly affecting its recovery efforts.
translated_content: ‘डंकी’ हा शाहरुख खानचा २०२३ मधील तिसरा चित्रपट असून, हे त्यांचे प्रसिद्ध दिग्दर्शक राजकुमार हिरानी यांच्यासोबतचे पहिले सहकार्य आहे. वर्षातील अत्यंत अपेक्षित टीझर खानच्या ५८ व्या वाढदिवशी उघड करण्यात आला, ज्यामुळे चाहत्यांमध्ये सोशल मीडियावर उत्साह निर्माण झाला. खानने ‘डंकी’चे वर्णन ‘हे साध्या, खरी माणसांची त्यांच्या स्वप्नांचा आणि इच्छा पूर्ण करण्यासाठीची कथा आहे. मैत्री, प्रेम, एकत्र येणे आणि घरपणाचा अर्थ याविषयी ही कथा आहे.’ हिरानींना 'उमद्या मनाचा कथाकार' असे संबोधित करून खानने चित्रपटाचा भाग होण्याचा मान असल्याचे सांगितले. उत्साही चाहत्यांनी या टीझरला खऱ्या अर्थाने SRK च्या पुनरागमनाचे स्वरूप दिले, तसेच अनेकांनी त्यांच्या भावना प्रधान भूमिकांमध्ये पाहणे जास्त आवडते, असे मत व्यक्त केले. काहींनी SRK-हिरानी यांच्या जोडीमुळे हा चित्रपट विशेषतः परदेशात बॉक्स ऑफिसवर नवे विक्रम प्रस्थापित करेल, अशी शक्यता व्यक्त केली. टीझरमध्ये विनोद व भावना मिसळलेली बेकायदेशीर स्थलांतरावरील ट्रॅजिकॉमेडी सुचवली आहे. सुरुवातीला सीमेवर तणावपूर्ण हालचाल दाखवली आहे, त्यानंतर अमृतसरमधील एका शीख कुटुंबात स्थलांतरावर वाद सुरू आहे, आणि SRK चा हार्डी पात्र कुस्ती, प्रेमप्रकरण आणि कुटुंबाला लंडनला नेण्याचा प्रयत्न करताना दिसतो. या चित्रपटात तापसी पन्नू आणि बोमन ईरानी यांच्या प्रमुख भूमिका असून, विक्की कौशल आणि दिया मिर्झा यांच्या खास उपस्थिती आहेत. ‘डंकी’ २२ डिसेंबर २०२३ रोजी चित्रपटगृहात प्रदर्शित होणार आहे, याच दिवशी प्रभासच्या ‘सालार’ या तेलगू अ‍ॅक्शन चित्रपटाशी स्पर्धा होईल. इतर बातम्यांमध्ये: भारतातील सर्वात मोठ्या टेलिकॉम कंपन्यांनी मायक्रोसॉफ्ट व अ‍ॅमेझॉन या आंतरराष्ट्रीय तंत्रज्ञान कंपन्या व्हॉट्सअ‍ॅपवरून व्यावसायिक संदेश पाठवून कायदेशीर टेलीकॉम मार्ग बाजूला काढत असल्याची तक्रार केली आहे, ज्यामुळे महसुली तोटा होऊ शकतो. भारतीय सरकारने अ‍ॅपलला संसदेतल्या विरोधी नेत्यांच्या आयफोनवर झालेल्या संशयित सरकारी हॅकिंगप्रकरणी चौकशीसह सहभाग मागितला आहे. दिवाळखोरीत गेलेल्या गो फर्स्ट विमान कंपनीला भाड्याने घेतलेली विमाने व इंजिने मालकांना परत देता येतील, असे विमान प्राधिकरणाने दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालयात सांगितले आहे, ज्याचा त्याच्या पुनरुत्थानावर परिणाम होऊ शकतो.

article_content: The South Korean group DKB is preparing for a much-anticipated comeback on November 30 KST. This return features a key change: the group will now have eight members, following Theo's recent departure. Brave Entertainment announced on November 7 that the remaining eight members will return with a new mini album, stating, "The eight group members will stage a grand comeback with a new mini album on November 30. The album will showcase the group's signature 'high performance.' For the first time since their debut, we are filming a new music video for the latest song on location in Los Angeles, signaling our broadened vision." On the same day, the agency released new profile photos of the current eight members, notably without Theo, who left the group after a controversy involving drunk driving. DKB's comeback comes about three months after the group released their 6th mini repackage album, 'We Love You.' DKB debuted in 2020 with the mini album 'Youth' and rapidly earned recognition, including making it into the 'Top 4' on JTBC's 'Peak Time.' Addressing Theo's departure, Brave Entertainment said, "We apologize to fans for sharing this difficult news. On October 30, our artist Theo was caught drunk driving by police and had his license revoked. We made it clear that drunk driving cannot be excused for any reason. After thorough discussions, we accepted Theo's decision to leave the group to avoid harming the team. He is now reflecting on his actions. We acknowledge the seriousness of this issue and our responsibility. We will strive to guide and educate our artists. We apologize again for causing concern to fans. Moving forward, DKB will reorganize as an eight-member group and continue their activities. We will fully support DKB's growth and ask fans to keep supporting the eight members as they prepare for their comeback, even under challenging circumstances." As DKB enters the final stage of preparations for their November 30 comeback, fans are eagerly awaiting the group's return.
translated_content: दक्षिण कोरियन समूह DKB ३० नोव्हेंबर KST रोजी बहुप्रतीक्षित कमबॅकसाठी सज्ज होत आहे. या परतीत एक महत्त्वपूर्ण बदल आहे: आता थीओच्या अलीकडच्या निर्गमनानंतर गटात आठ सदस्य राहतील. Brave Entertainment ने ७ नोव्हेंबर रोजी जाहीर केले की उरलेले आठ सदस्य नवीन मिनी अल्बमसह परतणार आहेत. कंपनीने म्हटले, "आठ सदस्यांचा गट ३० नोव्हेंबर रोजी नवीन मिनी अल्बमसह भव्य कमबॅक करणार आहे. हा अल्बम गटाच्या प्रसिद्ध 'हाय परफॉर्मन्स'ला दाखवेल. त्यांच्या डेब्यूनंतर प्रथमच आम्ही नवीन गाण्यासाठी लॉस एंजेलिसमध्ये ऑन-लोकेशन म्युझिक व्हिडिओ शूट करत आहोत, ज्यामुळे आमच्या दृष्टीकोनाचा विस्तार दर्शवितो." त्याच दिवशी, एजन्सीने वर्तमान आठ सदस्यांचे प्रोफाइल फोटो प्रसिद्ध केले, विशेष म्हणजे थीओशिवाय; कारण तो मद्यप्राशन करून गाडी चालविल्याच्या वादानंतर गटातून बाहेर पडला. DKB चा हा कमबॅक अंदाजे तीन महिन्यांनंतर येतो, जेव्हा गटाने त्यांचा सहावा मिनी रिपॅकेज अल्बम 'We Love You' प्रदर्शित केला होता. DKB ने २०२० मध्ये 'Youth' या मिनी अल्बमसह पदार्पण केले आणि पटकन ओळख मिळवली, तसेच JTBC च्या 'Peak Time' मध्ये 'Top 4' मध्ये स्थान पटकावले. Brave Entertainment ने थीओच्या गटातून जाण्यावर भाष्य करताना सांगितले, "आम्ही DKB समर्थकांना हे दु:खद बातमी देत आहोत याबद्दल क्षमस्व आहोत. ३० ऑक्टोबर रोजी आमचे कलाकार थीओ यांना पोलिसांनी मद्यपी अवस्थेत गाडी चालविल्याबद्दल पकडले आणि त्यांचे वाहनचालक परवाना रद्द करण्यात आले. आम्ही स्पष्ट केले की कोणत्याही कारणास्तव मद्यप्राशन करून वाहन चालविणे माफ केले जाऊ शकत नाही. सखोल चर्चेनंतर, थीओने गटाला हानी पोहोचू नये म्हणून स्वतःहून गटातून बाहेर पडण्याचा निर्णय घेतला, आणि आम्ही तो निर्णय स्वीकारला. तो आता आपल्या वर्तनावर मनापासून विचार करत आहे. आम्ही या गोष्टीची गांभीर्याने दखल घेतो आणि आमचे कर्तव्य समजतो. आम्ही आमच्या कलाकारांचे मार्गदर्शन व शिक्षण देण्यासाठी प्रयत्न करत राहू. पुन्हा एकदा चाहत्यांची चिंता वाढवल्याबद्दल क्षमस्व. पुढे DKB आठ-सदस्यीय गट म्हणून पुन्हा संघटित होईल आणि त्यांची कारकीर्द सुरू राहील. आम्ही DKB च्या वाढीसाठी पूर्ण पाठिंबा देऊ आणि कठीण परिस्थितीत तरी कमबॅकची तयारी करणाऱ्या आठ सदस्यांना चाहत्यांनी प्रोत्साहन द्यावे असे विनंती करतो." DKB त्यांच्या ३० नोव्हेंबरच्या कमबॅकच्या शेवटच्या टप्प्यात आहेत आणि चाहते त्या परतीची उत्सुकतेने वाट पाहत आहेत.

Elan Gale, a producer known for 'The Bachelor,' came under criticism after his widely shared live-tweeting of a supposed argument with an airline passenger over Thanksgiving weekend turned out to be fictional. The story, which went viral and garnered public sympathy for Gale, was later acknowledged by him on Twitter to be made up. The media rapidly shared the story without proper fact-checking. Some argue that Gale, as a creative professional, was simply telling a story, but the incident highlights how quickly compelling narratives can spread online, regardless of their truthfulness.

This raises questions about the ethics of live-tweeting strangers’ conversations. The author recounts live-tweeting a couple’s breakup (#roofbreakup) on a Brooklyn rooftop, which also went viral, receiving largely positive responses. However, not everyone approves; Nisha Chittal, a social media editor at MSNBC, wrote that broadcasting private exchanges—even anonymously—can be unfair. She referenced several incidents, including Gale’s hoax and a case involving former NSA director Michael Hayden. The author maintains that sharing such stories can be acceptable if identities are protected, though acknowledges that technology is making the lines between public and private increasingly unclear. The piece concludes that anecdotes resonate when they are relatable, but advocates for care in protecting personal details.

The views presented are those of the author, Kyle Ayers.

article_content: More than two years after losing her three young children in a devastating house fire, Samantha Hudson, aged 29, has passed away. The tragic incident took place in November 2010 at their home in Bridlington, East Yorkshire. The fire claimed the lives of William Beal (9), Antony Fothergill (5), and Maddie Hudson (3), who all succumbed to smoke inhalation. Samantha survived the initial blaze but suffered severe injuries, including brain damage from which she never recovered. She spent time in a coma and, after regaining consciousness, was left unable to walk or feed herself. Over the following years, her family visited her and cherished the moments they could still be with her, though she remained significantly disabled. Sharon Hudson, Samantha's mother, expressed her sorrow, stating that while they could previously visit, hold, and talk to Samantha, now she is truly gone and will be deeply missed. She added that she hopes Samantha is now reunited with her children. Investigations into the cause of the fire determined that a discarded cigarette had set fire to clothing under a bay window while Samantha had fallen asleep in the living room. Awakened by the smoke alarm, she attempted to save her children by gathering them in a bedroom, where firefighters later found them together. A coroner ruled the children's deaths accidental, describing the loss as an unimaginable tragedy. Samantha Hudson's funeral is expected to be held in the coming week.

A driver managed to evade police after flipping his black Ford Focus onto the roof of a bungalow in Benfleet, Essex. The incident began when the man failed to stop for a routine check around 7pm on Wednesday. During the ensuing chase, the car veered off the road, crashed through a tree, and landed upside down on a bungalow roof. The force of the crash destroyed the vehicle's tyres and caused significant damage to the roof.

Despite the severity of the crash, the driver exited the vehicle and fled before police could apprehend him. Officers, supported by a helicopter and sniffer dogs, searched the area but were unable to locate him. Police believe the driver may have sustained injuries.

The bungalow was unoccupied at the time, as its previous resident had moved to a care home four months prior. Emergency services, including paramedics and firefighters, responded quickly; firefighters ensured the building was safe after large parts of the roof were splintered by the impact.

Neighbours described the event as shocking. Grace Ayres, 83, said it 'sounded like a bomb going off,' while Bernard Connor, 72, remarked on the speed of the car and expressed relief that no pedestrians were present. Another resident, photographer Jo Tennant, noted the quietness of the street, making the incident even more surprising. An unnamed neighbour described hearing the impact and seeing police search the area.

Essex Police stated that enquiries are ongoing and they are seeking information regarding the driver’s whereabouts.

article_content: Stephane Dahirel doesn't directly claim that eating chicken will save the planet, but he implies this while showcasing his intensive farm in Brittany, western France. Inside a shed, 30,000 chickens will more than triple in size within a month, and their meat will have a relatively low carbon footprint. "The objective is to produce the best meat possible, in the least amount of time, with the least amount of food," said Dahirel. Dahirel produces two million chickens annually, mainly for McDonald's nuggets. These chickens reach slaughter weight in under half the time compared to traditional farming. After 20 days, each chicken weighs about one kilo—twenty times their birth weight. By the time they are processed at 45 days, they exceed three kilos. According to the UN's Food and Agricultural Organization (FAO), chicken has the lowest carbon footprint among meats—producing less than half the CO2 per kilo compared to pork, and 30 times less than beef. Whereas cattle emit considerable methane, chickens generate very little—comparable to rice, or even less with intensive methods. Dahirel contends that intensive farming is the most efficient and rational method for meat production, both economically and ecologically. Nevertheless, it also brings disadvantages. The grain used to feed the chickens requires significant land, synthetic fertilizers, and pesticides, impacting biodiversity and water quality. Green algae blooms on the beaches of Brittany, partly the result of intensive pork, poultry, and dairy farming, have raised environmental alarms and have been linked to several deaths. Intensive farming raises animal welfare issues as well. Dahirel houses 20 chickens per square meter, using bedding of wood shavings and buckwheat hulls to absorb waste. Sick or abnormal chickens are euthanized to prevent suffering and to ensure consistent quality for automated processing. "They are not robots, but we seek uniformity," Dahirel says from his home, overlooking his sheds, which are equipped with solar panels. While chicken could be the most efficient animal protein in terms of carbon emissions, experts caution that it is not automatically better for overall environmental health. "If we only consider CO2 emissions per kilo, everyone would eat chicken—but that would be a mistake," says Pierre-Marie Aubert of the IDDRI think tank. "If you focus solely on carbon, other unintended consequences may occur over time." Aubert notes that global chicken consumption has risen sharply, making it one of the most widely consumed meats without the religious or cultural taboos seen with pork and beef. Lucile Rogissart of the Institute for Climate Economics (I4CE) adds that while there's much attention on methane emissions from cattle and sheep, simply replacing beef with chicken is not enough. A true climate solution would require reducing overall meat consumption.

"हेतू म्हणजे शक्य तितक्या कमी वेळात, कमी अन्न वापरून उत्तम दर्जाचे मांस तयार करणे," असे डाहितरेल सांगतात. डाहितरेल दरवर्षी दोन दशलक्ष कोंबड्या पिकवतात, मुख्यत्वे मॅकडोनाल्ड्सच्या नगेट्ससाठी. या कोंबड्या पारंपारिक शेतांच्या तुलनेत अर्ध्या वेळातच कत्तलीसाठी तयार होतात. २० दिवसांनी प्रत्येक कोंबडी सुमारे एक किलो वजनाची असते — जन्माच्या वजनापेक्षा वीसपट जास्त. ४५ दिवसांनी कोंबडीचे वजन तीन किलोपेक्षा जास्त होते. संयुक्त राष्ट्रांच्या खाद्य व कृषी संघटनेनुसार, चिकनचे कार्बन फूटप्रिंट सर्व मांस प्रकारांमध्ये सर्वात कमी आहे — प्रत्येक किलोमध्ये पोक किंवा गोमांसाच्या तुलनेत CO2चे प्रमाण खूपच कमी. गोमांस आणि डुक्कर मोठ्या प्रमाणात मिथेन उत्सर्जन करतात, तर कोंबड्या अतिशय कमी, तांदुळाइतपत किंवा इंटेंसिव्ह पद्धतीने अजून कमी कार्बन उत्सर्जन करतात, असे FAO सांगते. डाहितरेल म्हणतात की इंटेंसिव्ह फार्मिंग ही आर्थिक व पर्यावरणीय दृष्टिकोनातून मांस उत्पादन करण्यासाठी सर्वात कार्यक्षम आणि तर्कसंगत पद्धत आहे. परंतु, त्याचे काही गंभीर तोटेही आहेत. कोंबड्यांसाठी लागणारे धान्य पिकवण्यासाठी मोठ्या प्रमाणावर जमीन, रासायनिक खतं आणि कीटकनाशकांची आवश्यकता लागते, ज्याचा जैवविविधता व पाण्याच्या दर्जावर परिणाम होतो. ब्रेटनीमधील किनार्‍यांवर हिरव्या शैवळाचा फैलाव — जो एका अंशतः पोर्क, पोल्ट्री व दुग्ध व्यवसायामुळे — पर्यावरणीय चिंता निर्माण करतो आणि काही मृत्यूंची कारणीभूत ठरला आहे. इंटेंसिव्ह पद्धतीस प्राणी कल्याणाच्या बाबतीतही समस्या आहेत. डाहितरेल एका चौरस मीटरला २० कोंबड्या ठेवतात, जिथे लाकडाच्या भुसा व बकव्हीटच्या सालांचे आच्छादन घालून पाडव्यांचे मल शोषले जाते. आजारी किंवा अपुरी वाढती कोंबडी वेदना टाळण्यासाठी व एकसारखी गुणवत्ता राखण्यासाठी मारली जाते. "ते रोबोट नाहीत, पण आम्ही घनता व एकसारखपणा पाहतो," असे डाहितरेल त्यांच्या घरातून सौर पॅनल्स लावलेल्या शेडकडे पाहून म्हणतात. कार्बन उत्सर्जनाच्या दृष्टीने चिकन हे प्रभावी प्रथिन स्रोत असू शकते, परंतु निसर्गासाठी ते स्वयमेव चांगले असेलच, असे काही नाही, असे तज्ज्ञ सांगतात. "जर आपण केवळ CO2 उत्सर्जन पाहून निर्णय घेतला, तर सगळे चिकनच खातील — पण हे मोठं चुक होईल," असे IDDRI या संस्थेचे पियरे-मारी ओबेर सांगतात. "फक्त कार्बनवर लक्ष दिल्यास अनेक अनपेक्षित परिणाम उद्भवू शकतात." ओबेर म्हणतात, जगभर चिकनच्या वापरात मोठी वाढ झाली आहे, कारण चिकनला पोर्क किंवा गोमांसासारख्या धार्मिक किंवा सांस्कृतिक निर्बंधांचा सामना करावा लागत नाही. Institute for Climate Economics (I4CE) च्या ल्युसिल रॉजिसार्ट सांगतात की जरी जनावरांतून येणाऱ्या मिथेनवर भर दिला जातोय, तरी केवळ गोमांसाऐवजी चिकन खाणे पुरेसे नाही. हवामान बदलाच्या दृष्टीने एकूणच मांसाचा वापर कमी करणे आवश्यक आहे.

article_content:
New Zealand Test cricketer Henry Nicholls has been accused of breaching New Zealand Cricket’s code of conduct for alleged ball tampering during a domestic first-class match this week. Umpires reported the incident following television footage from the Plunket Shield match between Nicholls' Canterbury team and Auckland, which appeared to show him brushing the ball against a helmet during a change of ends.

"Nicholls has been reported for allegedly breaching Rule 3.1, article 1.15 of the Code during Day 3 of the Plunket Shield match between Canterbury and Auckland at Hagley Oval," New Zealand Cricket stated on Friday. This rule pertains to changing the condition of the ball in violation of Law 41.3 of the Laws of Cricket.

The case has been referred to a commissioner for first-class cricket, but a hearing date has yet to be determined. Nicholls, who is included in New Zealand’s squad set to tour Bangladesh later this month, has not commented on the charge.

This statement from New Zealand Cricket comes as the national team’s limited-overs players participate in the Cricket World Cup in India. New Zealand’s recent victory over Sri Lanka on Thursday has brought them closer to a semifinal berth. However, the off-field controversy involving Nicholls now adds a new twist to the team’s campaign. The outcome of the hearing may have implications for Nicholls’ immediate playing future and could impact New Zealand’s plans for the upcoming Bangladesh tour. (With inputs from AP)

न्यूझीलंडचे कसोटी क्रिकेटपटू हेन्री निकोल्स यांच्यावर या आठवड्यात झालेल्या देशांतर्गत प्रथम श्रेणी सामन्यात चेंडूची छेडछाड (बॉल टॅम्परिंग) केल्याचा आरोप आहे. कॅंटरबरी विरुद्ध ऑकलंड या प्लंकेट शिल्ड सामन्यादरम्यान, एंड बदलताना निकोल्सने चेंडू हेल्मेटला घासल्याचे टेलिव्हिजन फुटेज आणि पंचांच्या अहवालातून स्पष्ट झाले आहे.

"कॅंटरबरी आणि ऑकलंड यांच्यात हॅग्ली ओव्हलवर झालेल्या प्लंकेट शिल्ड सामन्याच्या तिसऱ्या दिवशी निकोल्सवर नियम 3.1, अनुच्छेद 1.15 चा भंग केल्याचा आरोप करण्यात आला आहे," असे न्यूजीलंड क्रिकेटने शुक्रवारी म्हटले. हा नियम चेंडूच्या स्थितीमध्ये बदल करण्यावर आहे, जो 'लॉ 41.3' च्या उल्लंघनात येतो.

ही बाब प्रथम श्रेणी क्रिकेटच्या कमिशनरकडे पाठवण्यात आली असून अजून सुनावणीची तारीख जाहीर झालेली नाही. या महिन्याच्या अखेरीस बांगलादेश दौऱ्यावर जाणाऱ्या न्यूजीलंड संघात निकोल्सचा समावेश असून, त्यांनी या आरोपावर काहीही भाष्य केलेले नाही.

दरम्यान, न्यूजीलंडचा मर्यादित षटकांचा संघ सध्या भारतातील क्रिकेट विश्वचषकात खेळत आहे. गुरुवारी श्रीलंकेवर मिळवलेल्या विजयानंतर संघ उपांत्य फेरीच्या जवळ पोहोचला आहे. पण निकोल्सवरील हा वाद संघाच्या मोहिमेत अनपेक्षित वळण घेऊन आला आहे. सुनावणीचा निकाल निकोल्सच्या तात्काळ क्रिकेट कारकिर्दीसाठी आणि बांगलादेश दौऱ्यासाठी संघाच्या योजनांवर परिणाम करू शकतो. article_content: The stock market experienced another turbulent session on Friday, concluding one of the most eventful weeks on Wall Street in years. However, the Dow Jones Industrial Average closed higher, rising more than 250 points after strong earnings reports from Morgan Stanley, General Electric, and Textron, as well as encouraging U.S. economic data. This upward movement followed four consecutive weeks of declines, which left the Standard & Poor's 500 index 6 percent below its record high set on September 18. On Friday, U.S. stocks opened higher as investors digested the latest corporate earnings and positive data showing increased home construction last month. Volatility dominated the week, with the Dow Jones plunging as much as 460 points on Wednesday, then rebounding with one of its best days of the year on Friday. Jack Ablin, chief investment officer at BMO Private Bank in Chicago, remarked, 'We had indiscriminate selling all week, and then today we had indiscriminate buying.' Analysts have warned investors to expect ongoing volatility due to concerns about weaker growth in Europe, falling oil prices, and their potential impact on U.S. corporate profits. Significant market swings were seen not only in U.S. stocks but also in bonds, overseas stock markets, and commodities. James Liu, global market strategist at JPMorgan Funds, noted that most of the week's swings were driven by global growth fears rather than market fundamentals. The VIX volatility index rose from 12 in mid-September to as high as 31 this week—above its historical average but far from the 80 mark reached during the 2008 financial crisis. Liu commented, 'This volatility, in a way, is purely psychological. This is the market returning to more normalized behavior.' On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average climbed 263.17 points (1.6%) to 16,380.41, following six consecutive days of losses. The S&P 500 gained 24 points (1.3%) to 1,886.76, and the Nasdaq rose 41.05 points (1%) to 4,258.44. General Electric’s stock rose 2.4% to $24.82 after the company exceeded analysts’ expectations, especially in its aviation and oil and gas divisions. As a diversified company, GE’s results are often viewed as a measure of the U.S. industrial sector’s health. Textron, another industrial conglomerate, had the second-largest gain in the S&P 500, climbing $2.99 (9%) to $36.65 after reporting earnings well above expectations. Overall, the S&P 500's industrial sector rose nearly 2%, making it the best performing sector for the day. The upcoming week will be especially busy, with 130 companies in the S&P 500 index, including major firms like American Express, Coca-Cola, AT&T, and IBM, scheduled to report earnings. Positive economic data further boosted sentiment. The University of Michigan consumer sentiment index unexpectedly rose to 86.4, the highest reading since July 2007 and higher than economists’ expectations. The Commerce Department reported a 6.3% increase in home construction, with builders breaking ground on 1.017 million homes at a seasonally adjusted annual rate. Homebuilders benefited from the news: Hovnanian Enterprises rose 6% to $3.71, and Beazer Homes increased 4% to $17.71. Oil prices rose slightly Friday but remained down 4% for the week due to ongoing concerns over weak global demand and high supply. U.S. crude settled at $82.75 a barrel, and Brent crude at $86.16. In other energy trading, wholesale gasoline closed at $2.233 a gallon, heating oil at $2.498 a gallon, and natural gas fell to $3.766 per 1,000 cubic feet. Gold dropped to $1,239 an ounce, silver fell to $17.33 an ounce, and copper rose to $3 a pound.
translated_content: शेअर बाजाराने शुक्रवारी आणखी एका अस्थिर सत्राचा अनुभव घेतला आणि वॉल स्ट्रीटवरील गेल्या काही वर्षांतील सर्वात घटनापूर्ण आठवड्याचा शेवट केला. मात्र, डाऊ जोन्स इंडस्ट्रियल अव्हरेजने मजबूत आर्थिक अहवाल आणि मॉर्गन स्टॅन्ली, जनरल इलेक्ट्रिक आणि टेक्सट्रॉन या कंपन्यांच्या चांगल्या तिमाही निकालांमुळे २५० पेक्षा जास्त अंकांनी वाढ नोंदवली. ही वाढ सलग चार आठवड्यांच्या घसरणीनंतर आली, ज्यामुळे स्टँडर्ड अँड पूअर्स ५०० निर्देशांक १८ सप्टेंबर रोजीच्या विक्रमी सर्वोच्च स्तरापेक्षा ६ टक्क्यांनी खाली होता. शुक्रवारी, गुंतवणूकदारांनी नवीन तिमाही निकाल आणि गेल्या महिन्यात घरनिर्मितीत झालेली वाढ याचा उल्लेख करत अमेरिकन शेअर्स वाढीने सुरू झाले. आठवडाभर बाजारामध्ये मोठी अस्थिरता दिसून आली; डाऊ जोन्स बुधवारी ४६० अंकांनी घसरला आणि शुक्रवारच्या सत्रात वर्षातील सर्वोत्तम वाढ नोंदवून पुनरुज्जीवित झाला. BMO प्रायव्हेट बँकेचे चीफ इन्व्हेस्टमेंट ऑफिसर जॅक अब्लिन म्हणाले, 'आपण संपूर्ण आठवडाभर तडकाफडकी विक्री केली, आणि आज तडकाफडकी खरेदी.' विश्लेषकांनी गुंतवणूकदारांना युरोपमधील कमकुवत वाढ, घसरलेली तेलाची किंमत आणि अमेरिकन कंपन्यांच्या नफ्यावर होणारा परिणाम यामुळे बाजारातील अस्थिरता टिकून राहू शकते, असा इशारा दिला आहे. या आठवड्यात केवळ अमेरिकन शेअर्स नव्हे, तर बाँड्स, परदेशी बाजार आणि कमोडिटीजमध्येही मोठ्या हालचाली झाल्या. JPMorgan Funds चे जागतिक बाजार रणनीतिकार जेम्स ल्य यांनी सांगितले, आठवड्यातील बहुतेक हालचाली जागतिक विकासावरील भीतीमुळे झाल्या, बाजाराच्या मूलभूत तत्त्वांमुळे नव्हे. VIX अस्थिरता निर्देशांकाने सप्टेंबरमध्ये १२ वरून या आठवड्यात ३१ पर्यंत वाढ केली — हा ऐतिहासिक सरासरीपेक्षा जास्त असला तरी २००८ च्या आर्थिक संकटातील ८० च्या पातळीपासून खूप खाली आहे. ल्य म्हणाले, 'ही अस्थिरता अंशतः मानसिक आहे. हा बाजार अधिक सामान्य वर्तनाकडे परत येतोय.' शुक्रवारी, डाऊ जोन्स इंडस्ट्रियल अव्हरेज २६३.१७ अंकांनी (१.६%) वाढून १६,३८०.४१ वर बंद झाला, सहा सलग घसरणीनंतर. article_content: Independent Artist Group has signed Terrence Howard, an Academy Award-nominated and Golden Globe-winning actor known for his roles in 'Hustle & Flow,' 'Crash,' and 'Empire,' for representation. Howard earned critical acclaim for his starring role as DJay in the Paramount film directed by Craig Brewer, portraying a Memphis pimp who aspires to become a successful hip-hop emcee. For his performance as TV director Cameron Thayer in the Lionsgate Best Picture winner 'Crash'—a film examining interwoven stories of race, loss, and redemption among Los Angeles citizens—he received the National Board of Review Award for Breakthrough Performance. Howard starred alongside Sandra Bullock, Don Cheadle, Brendan Fraser, and Matt Dillon. Throughout his career, Howard has worked with many top directors and actors. Other notable credits include Denis Villeneuve’s 'Prisoners' with Hugh Jackman, 'The Butler' with Lee Daniels, 'Iron Man' with Jon Favreau, 'The Brave One' with Jodie Foster, 'August Rush' with Robin Williams, and 'The Company You Keep' with Robert Redford. Howard can currently be seen opposite Dolph Lundgren in 'Showdown at the Grand,' an action thriller from Shout! Studios, where a movie theater owner must defend his family business with help from a legendary action star. Howard is also known for his portrayal of music mogul Lucious Lyon on Fox’s 'Empire,' and most recently appeared in the TV series 'The Best Man: The Final Chapters,' which became Peacock’s first original to enter Nielsen’s Top 10 streaming rankings this year. Among Howard’s upcoming projects is the Netflix film 'Shirley,' directed by John Ridley and starring Regina King as America’s first Black congresswoman, Shirley Chisholm. Howard continues to be managed by Mira Howard.

article_content: Virat Kohli celebrated his remarkable century during the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2023 semi-final against New Zealand at Mumbai's Wankhede Stadium on Wednesday. Hundreds of fans, dressed in jersey number 18, cheered for Kohli, who has sported this number since his under-19 days and continues to do so in the IPL. In a past interview with Star Sports, Kohli shared the significance of jersey number 18 in his life. He revealed that he never specifically requested the number, but it gained profound meaning because he debuted for India on August 18, 2008, and lost his father on December 18, 2006. 'Two of the most significant dates in my life happened to be 18. There has to be a cosmic connection with this number,' Kohli said. On Wednesday, Kohli scored 117 runs off 113 balls, becoming the first cricketer to hit 50 ODI centuries, surpassing Sachin Tendulkar's previous record. Kohli had equaled Tendulkar's tally of 49 centuries earlier, on his birthday, November 5, at Eden Gardens in Kolkata against South Africa. Vijay Lokapally, Kohli’s biographer, told AFP, 'Virat never played for records. They happened as he progressed. Longevity leads to milestones, and that is what Virat has inherited from stalwarts like Sunil Gavaskar, Kapil Dev, and Sachin Tendulkar.' After the milestone, Sachin Tendulkar congratulated Kohli on social media, expressing happiness that his record was broken by an Indian, and noting the special significance of it happening at the World Cup semi-final and Tendulkar's home ground. Kohli experienced a long period without centuries starting from 2021, going over 1,000 days without reaching three figures. He ended this streak in the 2022 T20 World Cup and has since maintained strong form, currently leading as top scorer in the World Cup with 711 runs in 10 innings. Meanwhile, fast bowler Mohammed Shami's exceptional performances have made him a sought-after brand ambassador, reportedly doubling his endorsement fees to around ₹1 crore per deal during the tournament. In economic news, the RBI has tightened capital norms for unsecured retail loans, requiring banks to reserve more capital and implement stricter board oversight to limit risks. Additionally, the Ministry of Mines has informed Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) that government approval will be needed for any reorganization of the company.

RPG Group chairman Harsh Goenka stirred up discussion online after he shared a picture with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on X (formerly Twitter). In the image, the two men are seen side by side in dark blue shirts, with an Israeli flag visible behind them. Goenka’s caption was a play on words, bringing together Netanyahu’s nickname “Bibi” with the Urdu term for “wife”: “Ek ‘bibi’ se ham war mein hain, Ek ‘Bibi’ se hamas war mein hai.” This loosely means, "I am in a dispute with my wife, while this Bibi (Netanyahu) is at war with Hamas."

The post gained substantial attention, attracting more than 54,000 views amid the ongoing Israel-Palestine conflict, following the Hamas attack on Israel on October 7, 2023. Responses were divided—some users appreciated the joke, while others condemned Goenka for making light of serious events, especially amid reports of significant casualties in Gaza due to Israeli retaliation. 

The article also refers to Netanyahu’s 2018 meeting with key Indian business leaders at the Taj Hotel in Mumbai, where Goenka was a participant.

article_content: Since her debut in 1959, Barbie has consistently adapted to evolving trends. Now, she’s entering the digital era with a revolutionary touchscreen dress made for today’s tech-savvy children. The newest Barbie features a dress with a 4.5 square inch touchscreen and 114 colorful LED lights. Children can create their own patterns or words on Barbie’s dress using their fingers or a stylus, or choose from ready-made graphics like hearts, dots, and stripes. The dress is also sound-activated, so the LED lights flash in sync with music, transforming Barbie into a disco star. Her necklace isn’t just for show—it acts as buttons to easily switch between display modes. ‘Digital Dress Barbie’ was unveiled at this week’s New York Toy Fair and was well-received by fans. While a UK release date has not been announced, the doll will arrive in the US in August, retailing for about $49.99 (£33). Created by Ruth and Elliot Handler in 1959, Barbie has appeared in countless variations—from bestsellers like ‘Totally Hair’ Barbie to the controversial ‘Drag Queen’ Barbie. Despite criticism about body image and feminism, Barbie remains one of the world’s most popular toys. Modern versions include princess Barbies, Yoga Barbie, and even a Barbie with tattoos. This isn’t Mattel’s first experiment with tech; last year’s Barbie Photo Fashion Doll doubled as a digital camera that displayed photos on her dress. Barbie’s new digital capabilities reflect the tech-savvy world of today’s children, who are already adept with devices like iPads. While some parents may miss traditional dress-up play, the new digital wardrobe offers fresh creative play opportunities with Barbie.

article_content: A grandfather may be forced to sell his home to pay £40,000 in legal fees after losing a High Court battle over parking tickets. Barry Moss, a retired roofer, launched a solo campaign against his local council, successfully appealing dozens of parking tickets on behalf of friends, family, and even strangers. He argued that Bolton Council’s parking bays and signage did not meet Department for Transport standards. However, when Moss took the council’s auditors, KPMG, to the High Court, claiming some of the council's parking income was obtained illegally, he lost the case. Now, KPMG’s lawyers have said he must sell his four-bedroom home to recover £40,000 in costs, plus interest. Mr Moss, 66, says he is being punished for standing up for motorists. He and his wife, Aline, built their home themselves in 1993, and it means everything to them. He regrets the stress the case has caused his wife but maintains that challenging the council was the right thing to do. Mr Moss appears in a BBC1 documentary, 'Parking Mad,' which follows individuals challenging councils over parking fines—including a man who fought £80,000 in tickets and a motorcycle group warning drivers about camera cars. Moss began his campaign after receiving a parking ticket five years ago for overstaying by four minutes due to an injured knee. Bolton Council told him he had to pay unless an ambulance had been called. Two months later, he successfully appealed his nephew’s ticket, arguing confusing markings near a new roundabout. He then pushed for refunds for others ticketed in the same spot, which were eventually granted. His efforts gained attention nationwide, leading to requests for help from people across the country. Moss claims that many councils have been issuing tickets unlawfully. The documentary claims councils have been issuing more parking fines than ever, estimating ticket revenue exceeded £700 million last year.

Delhi's primary schools will remain closed until November 10 due to worsening air pollution, Education Minister Atishi announced on Sunday. For students in grades 6 to 12, schools have the option to shift to online classes.

Delhi’s air quality index (AQI) plummeted from 415 on Saturday afternoon to 460 by Sunday morning, placing it firmly in the severe category for the first time this season. Last week, all government and private primary schools were ordered shut until November 5, but the continued deterioration has extended closures to November 10.

Under the central government’s pollution control plan, if AQI exceeds 450, emergency measures—such as bans on polluting vehicles, commercial four-wheelers, and all construction activities—are triggered across the National Capital Region (NCR). PM2.5 levels, known for causing respiratory issues, were recorded at seven to eight times the Indian safe limit (60 µg/m³), and 80–100 times higher than the World Health Organization's 5 µg/m³ guideline in several NCR locations.

Experts attribute the poor air quality to a combination of falling temperatures, stagnant air, and increased stubble burning in neighboring Punjab and Haryana.

शहराचा वायु गुणवत्ता निर्देशांक (AQI) शनिवारी दुपारी ४१५ वरून रविवारी सकाळी ४६० वर गेला, त्यामुळे या हंगामात पहिल्यांदाच 'गंभीर' स्तरात पोहोचला आहे. गेल्या आठवड्यात सर्व सरकारी आणि खासगी प्राथमिक शाळा ५ नोव्हेंबरपर्यंत बंद करण्याचे आदेश देण्यात आले होते, पण परिस्थिती आणखी बिघडल्यामुळे ही बंदी १० नोव्हेंबरपर्यंत वाढवण्यात आली आहे.

PM2.5 कण, जे आरोग्याला धोकादायक असतात, यांची पातळी भारतातील सुरक्षित मर्यादा (६० µg/m³) पेक्षा ७-८ पट, तर WHO मार्गदर्शित मर्यादा (५ µg/m³) पेक्षा ८०-१०० पट जास्त नोंदवली गेली आहे.

विशेषज्ञांचे म्हणणे आहे की तापमानातील घट, शांत वारे आणि पंजाब-हरियाणा भागातील पिकांच्या जाळपोळीमुळे दिल्लीच्या हवेची गुणवत्ता आणखी खालावली आहे.

article_content: More than 50 projects have been awarded a total of £1 billion in the third round of Levelling Up funding. The fund aims to tackle regional inequalities by supporting projects that improve transport and culture. Levelling Up minister Jacob Young stated that the funds would 'restore pride of place and improve everyday life' for communities. However, Labour's shadow minister Justin Madders described the funding as a 'drop in the ocean' and claimed it would not compensate for '13 years of neglect' under Conservative governments. This is the third tranche of Levelling Up Fund money. Earlier rounds in October 2021 and January 2023 provided £1.7 billion and £2.1 billion respectively. The Penistone rail line project, enhancing the railway between Sheffield and Huddersfield, received the largest single grant at £48 million. The previous funding round received criticism for favoring projects in the wealthier south-east. Announcing the latest allocations in Parliament, Mr Young emphasized that this round would benefit projects across the UK. He pointed out that, considering all three rounds, the north-east and north-west of England received more per capita funding than any other English regions, followed by the East Midlands and Yorkshire and Humber. The Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) expressed anger that Northern Ireland projects received nothing from this funding round. Mr Young attributed this to the absence of a functioning Northern Ireland government, but DUP's Treasury spokesman Sammy Wilson called this a 'flimsy excuse'. He accused the government of economic blackmail to pressure the assembly into reopening, and of favoring marginal Conservative constituencies. In previous rounds, local authorities had to submit bids, but this round selected winners from unsuccessful earlier applicants. Mr Young said this reflected the high quality of previous applications. Labour MP Michael Shanks asked if councils would be reimbursed for the costs of submitting applications. Mr Young responded that no refunds would be given, but noted the government is working toward a simpler funding process to better meet councils' needs. Last week, the government's spending watchdog warned that some Levelling Up projects may not meet deadlines due to a combination of inflation, skill shortages, and departmental decision-making challenges.

article_content: Florida police have shared video footage of a teenager putting a law enforcement helicopter crew at risk by shining a laser at their aircraft. The clip displays a green laser aimed at 'Alert 2,' a Seminole County Sheriff’s Office helicopter, briefly blinding the crew as they flew. Investigators identified the teenager as 19-year-old Trevor Ragno, who was seen on video walking near a swimming pool at a Longwood home before running to the front yard, with the helicopter hovering above. According to officials, the helicopter crew first observed the laser beam in their cockpit on Saturday night while flying at about 800 feet. The laser illuminated the cockpit multiple times, creating glare and temporarily impairing the pilots’ vision—similar to a camera flash. Using Forward Looking Infrared, the crew located Ragno and directed officers on the ground to the site, where he was apprehended. Authorities highlighted that shining lasers at aircraft is extremely hazardous, as it can cause pilots to lose focus and become disoriented. Both the FBI Task Force and the FAA were informed of the incident. Ragno was taken to the John E. Polk Correctional Facility, charged with a felony for pointing a laser at an aircraft and for culpable negligence. He was released after posting a $1,100 bond.

article_content:
Extreme heat could cause nearly five times more deaths by 2050 if urgent measures to address climate change are not taken, according to an international team of experts. The Lancet Countdown, a leading annual assessment by top researchers and institutions, warns that global warming—driven largely by continued fossil fuel use—poses a grave risk to human health in numerous ways. These include increased deadly heatwaves, more frequent droughts threatening food security, the wider spread of infectious diseases like dengue by mosquitoes, and mounting pressure on health systems.

The report comes during what is expected to be the hottest year in recorded history; just last week, Europe’s climate monitor announced that the previous month was the warmest October ever. Later this month, COP28 climate talks in Dubai will, for the first time, feature a "health day" on December 3 to highlight the health impacts of global warming.

Despite growing awareness and calls for change, carbon emissions related to energy production reached new highs last year. The report criticizes continued government subsidies and private investments in fossil fuels.

In 2022, people worldwide faced an average of 86 days of life-threatening temperatures; the Lancet Countdown study attributes 60% of these extreme heat events to climate change. Seniors are especially at risk—the number of people over 65 dying from heat grew by 85% between 1991-2000 and 2013-2022.

Executive director Marina Romanello warns these harms might be only a preview of a far more dangerous future. Should global temperatures rise by 2°C by the end of the century—a likely scenario given current trends—annual heat-related deaths could increase by 370%, or nearly fivefold, by 2050. Additionally, around 520 million more people may suffer from moderate or severe food insecurity by mid-century.

The report also projects a 36% rise in dengue transmission with 2°C warming. Over a quarter of cities surveyed fear that climate change might overwhelm their ability to cope. Georgiana Gordon-Strachan of the Lancet Countdown, from Jamaica (currently enduring a dengue outbreak), emphasized that low-income countries, which contribute least to greenhouse gas emissions, suffer the most severe health impacts.

World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus labeled limiting global warming to the 1.5°C Paris Agreement target a "public health imperative" and warned that current national pledges will only cut emissions 2% by 2030 compared to 2019 levels—well short of the needed 43% reduction. Romanello cautioned that unless real progress is made, health-focused discussions risk being "empty words."

Nevertheless, the report identifies some hopeful signs: deaths from fossil fuel air pollution are down 16% since 2005, mostly due to less coal use; global investment in green energy reached $1.6 trillion last year, up 15% from the previous year and more than fossil fuel investments. Furthermore, adopting healthier, lower-carbon diets could prevent up to 12 million deaths per year and cut emissions from red meat and dairy production by 57%.

'द लँसेट काउंटडाउन', या अग्रगण्य वार्षिक अहवालानुसार, जीवाश्म इंधनांच्या सातत्याने वापरामुळे होणाऱ्या जागतिक तापमानवाढीमुळे माणसाच्या आरोग्याला गंभीर धोका निर्माण झाला आहे. ह्या धोक्यांमध्ये वाढलेल्या उष्णतेच्या लाटांपासून, वारंवार दुष्काळ, अन्नसुरक्षेला धोका, डेंग्यूसारख्या संसर्गजन्य आजारांचा वाढता प्रसार, आणि आरोग्य यंत्रणेवरचा भार यांचा समावेश होतो.

हा अहवाल मानवाच्या नोंदवलेल्या इतिहासातील सर्वात जास्त तापमान असलेल्या वर्षात प्रसिद्ध झाला आहे. गेल्या आठवड्यात युरोपच्या हवामान निरीक्षकांनी जाहीर केले की, गेल्या महिना हा सर्वोच्च तापमानाचा ऑक्टोबर होता. यावर्षी दुबई येथे होणाऱ्या COP28 परिषदेत 3 डिसेंबर रोजी प्रथमच 'हेल्थ डे' घेतला जाणार आहे, जिथे हवामान बदलाचा आरोग्यावर होणारा परिणाम अधोरेखित केला जाईल.

जागतिक पातळीवरील वाढत्या जागरूकतेनंतरही, ऊर्जा निर्मितीशी संबंधित कार्बन उत्सर्जन नेहमीच्या उच्चांकावर पोहोचले आहे. अहवालात अजूनही सुरू असलेल्या सरकारी अनुदान आणि खासगी गुंतवणुकीमुळे जीवाश्म इंधन क्षेत्राला मदत होत असल्यावर टीका करण्यात आली आहे.

2022 मध्ये, जगभरात लोकांनी सरासरी 86 दिवस जीवघेण्या उष्णतेला सामोरे जावे लागले; लँसेट काउंटडाउनच्या अभ्यासानुसार, त्यातील 60% दिवस हवामान बदलामुळेच शक्य झाले. ज्येष्ठ नागरिक सर्वाधिक धोक्यात असून, 65 वर्षांवरील उष्णतेमुळे मृत्यू 1991-2000 आणि 2013-2022 या कालावधीत 85% नी वाढले आहेत.

कार्यकारी संचालक मरीना रोमानेल्लो यांनी हे आजचे परिणाम पुढे आणखी गंभीर संकटाची केवळ सुरुवात असल्याचा इशारा दिला. या शतकाच्या अखेरीस जागतिक तापमानात 2°C पर्यंत वाढ झाली (सद्यस्थिती 2.7°C कडे आहे) तर उष्णतेशी संबंधित वार्षिक मृत्यू 2050 पर्यंत 370% म्हणजे सुमारे पाचपट वाढू शकतात. याशिवाय, सुमारे 52 कोटी लोकांना मध्यम किंवा गंभीर अन्न असुरक्षिततेचा सामना करावा लागेल.

अहवालानुसार, 2°C तापमानवाढीने डेंग्यूचा प्रसार 36% नी वाढेल. चौथ्या भागापेक्षा जास्त शहरांनी चिंता व्यक्त केली आहे की हवामान बदल त्यांच्या क्षमतेस पुरा पडू शकतो. जमैकाची जॉर्जियाना गॉर्डन-स्ट्राचान (सध्या जमैकामध्ये डेंग्यूचा उद्रेक) यांनी म्हटले, कमी आर्थिक साधनांच्या देशांना—जे हरितगृह वायू उत्सर्जनासाठी कमी जबाबदार आहेत—आरोग्यावर सर्वात जास्त परिणाम होतो.

जागतिक आरोग्य संघटनेचे प्रमुख टेड्रोस अधानॉम गेबरेयेसस यांनी पॅरिस करारातील 1.5°C मर्यादा ही 'सार्वजनिक आरोग्याची गरज' असल्याचे स्पष्टपणे सांगितले व सध्याच्या राष्ट्रीय वचनबद्धता 2030 पर्यंत केवळ 2% उत्सर्जन कपात करतील—जे 43% गरजेनुसार अत्यल्प आहे. रोमानेल्लो यांनी इशारा दिला की, खरं बदल घडला नाही तर आरोग्यावरचा भर हा फक्त 'रिकाम्या शब्दां'पुरता मर्यादित राहू शकतो.

तरीही, काही आशादायक गोष्टीही आहेत: जीवाश्म इंधनामुळे हवेतील प्रदूषणामुळे होणारे मृत्यू 2005 पासून 16% नी घटले आहेत, त्यात विशेषतः कोळशाचा वापर कमी करणं हे मोठं कारण आहे. हरितऊर्जेत जागतिक गुंतवणूक गेल्या वर्षी 1.6 ट्रिलियन डॉलरवर पोहोचली, जी 15% ची वाढ आहे आणि जीवाश्म इंधनापेक्षा जास्त आहे. तसेच, आरोग्यपूर्ण आणि कमी-कार्बन आहार घेतल्यास दरवर्षी 1.2 कोटी मृत्यू टाळले जाऊ शकतात आणि मांस व दुग्ध उत्पादनातील उत्सर्जन 57% नी कमी होईल.

article_content: At the Royal Windsor Horse Show yesterday, Autumn Phillips was seen curtseying deeply in respect for Queen Elizabeth II as Her Majesty arrived in her Range Rover. Her husband, Peter Phillips, watched as Autumn, the Canadian-born daughter-in-law of Princess Anne, followed royal protocol precisely. Members of the Royal Family observe strict traditions about curtseying, determined by the Order of Precedence. Peter Phillips, the son of Princess Anne and Captain Mark Phillips, attended with Autumn and their daughters, Isla and Savannah. The family enjoyed rides at the show, including a carousel. Autumn, aged 36 and originally from Montreal, has kept her Canadian citizenship since moving to London after marrying the Queen’s grandson in 2008. She appeared relaxed while spending time with her family. Prince Philip, 92, also attended the event. He actively set up his vantage point at Home Park in Windsor Castle, acting as an obstacle judge in the Land Rover International Driving Grand Prix. Despite recent health issues, Prince Philip looked well and independently set up his chair before settling down for lunch with other judges. According to an onlooker, Prince Philip stayed for almost five hours, seeming content. The Queen visited him periodically during the afternoon.

article_content: The flyover of two Russian nuclear-capable Bear Tu-95 bombers along Britain’s South Coast, creating hazards for civilian airliners, highlights the ongoing military threat posed by Russia under Vladimir Putin. On Wednesday, two RAF Typhoon jets — capable of traveling at twice the speed of sound — scrambled from RAF Lossiemouth in Scotland and RAF Coningsby in Lincolnshire to intercept the Russian aircraft. These bombers were first detected by Norwegian allies, then tracked by RAF radar at Staxton Wold (Yorkshire) and Neatishead (Norfolk). At RAF Boulmer in Northumberland, the Aerospace Surveillance and Control Systems Force Command relayed alerts to Whitehall and Britain’s military HQ in Northwood. The Typhoons were launched swiftly in response. Although these Russian bombers were unescorted and could, in theory, have been shot down before launching any weapons, their approach remains a stark reminder of ongoing military provocations. A similar incident occurred in September last year, and in November RAF fighters were scrambled twice in a week over the North Sea, with many such incidents reported over recent years. For political reasons, British defense officials have at times downplayed Russian military activity. In 2008, a Russian supersonic bomber carried out a simulated nuclear attack on northern England, coming within 90 seconds of UK airspace before turning back. Initial Ministry of Defence denials were later contradicted by leaked reports. In this week’s incident, civil aircraft over the Channel had to be rerouted for safety. The UK Foreign Office summoned the Russian ambassador for a formal warning — a more assertive response than in past years. The article asserts that Russia’s intentions are to intimidate and gather intelligence. Russian warplanes sometimes fly with transponders (identification devices) switched off, rendering them invisible to civilian radar and increasing risk to airliners. Such conduct nearly caused a collision near Copenhagen last year. Beyond the immediate risk, the article argues that Russia collects valuable information through these maneuvers, observing RAF reaction times and tactics. Russia is also alleged to conduct espionage within NATO defense establishments. On the maritime front, Russian warships and submarines, sometimes equipped for electronic surveillance, operate near UK waters, seeking the acoustic signatures of British nuclear submarines — which, if detected, become more vulnerable. Britain’s ability to track Russian submarines diminished with the retirement of Nimrod aircraft five years ago, resulting in reliance on allied assistance. Military stand-offs in air and at sea are portrayed as high-stakes but potentially dangerous, especially if any NATO state responds by force, risking escalation. The UK is treaty-bound to defend the Baltic NATO states (Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania) in case of aggression. Intelligence gathered from Russian incursions could be critical in any conflict. Additional motivations for these flights may include retaliation for Western sanctions and for the UK’s investigation into the 2006 murder of Alexander Litvinenko, an assassination widely blamed on the Russian state. The article claims that diplomatic reluctance has hampered UK reactions to both these provocations and the Litvinenko case. Finally, the article notes recent statements from Russian military leadership about strengthening their nuclear arsenal. The author argues that Western weakness is not military but political, warning against complacency in the face of continued Russian challenges. Edward Lucas is Energy Editor at The Economist.
translated_content: रशियाच्या अण्वस्त्रक्षम Bear Tu-95 बॉम्बर्सनी ब्रिटनच्या दक्षिण किनाऱ्यावरून उड्डाण केल्यामुळे नागरी विमानांसाठी धोकादायक परिस्थिती निर्माण झाली; यामुळे व्लादिमीर पुतिन यांच्या नेतृत्वाखालील रशियाकडून उद्भवणाऱ्या सततच्या लष्करी धोक्याची पुन:पुष्टी होते. बुधवारी, दोन आरएएफ टायफून लढाऊ विमानांनी — दोन्ही ध्वनीपेक्षा दुप्पट वेगाने जाऊ शकणारी — स्कॉटलंडमधील आरएएफ लॉसीमाउथ आणि लिंकनशायरमधील आरएएफ कोनिंग्सबी येथून झेप घेतली आणि रशियन विमानांमध्ये सामील झाली. ही बॉम्बर्स आधी नॉर्वेजियन सहयोगींनी शोधली, त्यानंतर आरएएफच्या रायडार स्टेशनद्वारे (स्टॅक्सटन वुल्ड, यॉर्कशायर व निएटिसहेड, नॉरफोक) ट्रॅक करण्यात आली. नॉर्थम्बरलँडमधील आरएएफ बुल्मरमध्ये, एरोस्पेस सर्व्हिलन्स आणि कंट्रोल सिस्टिम्स फोर्स कमांडने व्हाइटहॉल आणि नॉर्थवुडमधील ब्रिटनच्या लष्करी मुख्यालयाला सतर्क केले. त्यामुळे टायफून्स तत्काळ प्रक्षिप्त करण्यात आले. ही रशियन बॉम्बर्स एकट्याच होत्या आणि कोणतेही शस्त्र डागण्यापूर्वी त्यांना खाली पाडता आले असते, पण हा प्रसंग सतत होत असलेल्या लष्करी उन्मत्ततेची आठवण करून देतो. सप्टेंबरमध्येसुद्धा असाच एक प्रकार घडला, आणि नोव्हेंबरमध्ये आरएएफ लढाऊ विमानांना उत्तर समुद्रावर दोनदा झेप घ्यावी लागली; असे अनेक प्रसंग गेल्या काही वर्षांत घडले आहेत. राजकीय कारणांमुळे, ब्रिटिश संरक्षण अधिकाऱ्यांनी काही वेळा रशियन लष्करी हालचाली कमी दाखवल्या. २००८ मध्ये, एका रशियन सुपरसॉनिक बॉम्बर्सनी उत्तरी इंग्लंडवर अनुकरणात्मक अण्वस्त्र हल्ल्याचा सराव केला होता; ते विमान यूकेच्या हवाई हद्दीत शिरण्याच्या ९० सेकंद आधी परतले. सुरुवातीला संरक्षण मंत्रालयाने हे नाकारले होते, पण नंतर अशी माहिती लीक झाली. या आठवड्यातील घटनेमध्ये, चॅनेलवरील नागरी विमानांना सुरक्षिततेच्या हेतूने मार्ग बदलावा लागला. यूकेच्या परराष्ट्र मंत्रालयाने रशियन राजदूताला कवायतीने बोलावून ताकीद दिली — मागील वर्षांच्या तुलनेत अधिक ठोस पाऊल. लेखात म्हंटले आहे की, रशियाचे उद्दिष्ट भीती दाखवणे आणि माहिती जमा करणे आहे. रशियन लढाऊ विमाने कधी कधी ट्रान्सपॉन्डर्स बंद ठेवतात, त्यामुळे ती नागरी रायडारला दिसत नाहीत आणि यात विमानांना धोका वाढतो. अशा वर्तनामुळे गेल्या वर्षी कोपनहेगनजवळ टक्केटोकीची वेळ आली होती. तातडीचा धोका ओलांडून, लेखात सांगितले आहे की रशियन या कृतींमधून मौल्यवान माहिती गोळा करतात — म्हणजे आरएएफचे प्रतिसाद वेळ, धोरणे आणि कौशल्ये ओळखतात. असेही म्हंटले आहे की, रशियन गुप्तहेर नाटोच्या संरक्षण यंत्रणांमध्ये काम करतात. समुद्रावर रशियन युद्धनौका आणि पाणबुडी (कधी कधी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक पाळत ठेवण्यासाठी सुसज्ज) ब्रिटिश पाण्यात फिरतात, आणि ब्रिटिश अण्वस्त्र पाणबुड्यांचे 'अकूस्टिक सिग्नेचर' ओळखतात — जे सापडल्यास त्या अधिक असुरक्षित होतात. निमरॉड विमाने निवृत्त केल्यामुळे ब्रिटनची रशियन पाणबुडी शोधण्याची क्षमता पाच वर्षांपूर्वी कमी झाली, त्यामुळे आता सहयोगींवर अवलंबून राहावे लागते. हवाई आणि समुद्री संघर्ष हे उच्च-जोखमीचे पण धोकादायक मानले जातात, विशेषत: कोणतेही नाटो राष्ट्र सामोरील आक्रमकतेला तात्काळ प्रतिसाद दिल्यास संघर्ष उधळू शकतो. एस्टोनिया, लाट्विया, लिथुआनिया या बाल्टिक नाटो राष्ट्रांना आक्रमण झाल्यास त्यांच्या संरक्षणासाठी ब्रिटन बांधिल आहे. रशियन घुसखोरांकडून जमा झालेली माहिती कोणत्याही संघर्षात महत्त्वाची ठरू शकते. या उड्डाणामागे पश्चिमेकडून लादलेल्या निर्बंध आणि २००६ मध्ये अलेक्झांडर लिट्विनेनको यांच्या हत्येच्या चौकशीवर प्रतिक्रिया म्हणूनही प्रेरणा असू शकते; ती हत्या मोठ्या प्रमाणावर रशियन राज्यावर आरोपली जाते. लेखात असे म्हटले आहे की, राजनैतिक अनुत्साहामुळे ब्रिटनची प्रतिक्रियेवर मर्यादा आली आहे. शेवटी, लेखात रशियन लष्करी नेत्यांच्या त्यांच्या अण्वस्त्र सैन्यवृद्धीच्या घोषणांची नोंद घेतली आहे. लेखक सांगतो की, पश्चिमेकडील कमजोरी लष्करी नसून राजकीय आहे आणि रशियन आव्हानांच्या पार्श्वभूमीवर निष्काळजीपणावर इशारा करतो. एडवर्ड ल्युकास हे दी इकॉनॉमिस्टचे एनर्जी एडिटर आहेत.
